=== settings.js.txt ===
(function(){
'use strict';

var csrf = window.REESTR_CSRF || '';
var state = {
    users: [],
    permission_groups: [],
    default_user: [],
    employees: [],
    current_user_id: null,
    is_admin: false,
    loaded: false,
};

function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }
function esc(s){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){
    return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]; }); }
function notify(msg, kind){
    var n = $('trackerNotif'); if (!n) return;
    n.textContent = msg;
    n.className = 'tracker-notification show' + (kind === 'error' ? ' error' : '');
    clearTimeout(n._t);
    n._t = setTimeout(function(){ n.classList.remove('show'); }, 4500);
}

var _pendingReqs = 0;
function _showLoader() {
    _pendingReqs++;
    var l = document.getElementById('globalLoader');
    if (l) l.classList.add('active');
}
function _hideLoader() {
    _pendingReqs = Math.max(0, _pendingReqs - 1);
    if (_pendingReqs === 0) {
        var l = document.getElementById('globalLoader');
        if (l) l.classList.remove('active');
    }
}
function api(url, opts){
    opts = opts || {};
    opts.headers = Object.assign({}, opts.headers || {});
    if (csrf && opts.method && opts.method !== 'GET') opts.headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = csrf;
    opts.credentials = 'same-origin';
    _showLoader();
    return fetch(url, opts).then(function(r){
        if (r.status === 401) { location.href = '/login'; return new Promise(function(){}); }
        if (!r.ok) return r.text().then(function(t){
            var m = 'HTTP ' + r.status;
            try { var j = JSON.parse(t); if (j.error) m += ' — ' + j.error; }
            catch(e){ if (t) m += ' — ' + t.slice(0,200); }
            throw new Error(m);
        });
        return r.json();
    }).finally(_hideLoader);
}

document.querySelectorAll('.settings-tab').forEach(function(tab){
    tab.addEventListener('click', function(){
        var id = this.getAttribute('data-tab');
        document.querySelectorAll('.settings-tab').forEach(function(t){ t.classList.toggle('active', t === tab); });
        document.querySelectorAll('.settings-panel').forEach(function(p){
            p.classList.toggle('active', p.id === 'sp-' + id);
        });
        if (id === 'holidays') loadHolidays();
        if (id === 'db') loadDbInfo();
        if (id === 'audit') loadAudit();
        if (id === 'plugins') loadPluginsManager();
        if (id === 'about') loadAbout();
    });
});

function loadUsers(){
    return api('/api/settings/users').then(function(d){
        state.users = d.users || [];
        state.permission_groups = d.permission_groups || [];
        state.default_user = d.default_user || [];
        state.current_user_id = d.current_user_id;
        state.is_admin = !!d.is_admin;
        state.loaded = true;
        renderUsers();
    }).catch(function(e){ notify('❌ ' + e.message, 'error'); });
}

function renderUsers(){
    var wrap = $('usersList'); if (!wrap) return;
    if (!state.users.length) { wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="dict-empty">Нет пользователей</div>'; return; }
    var html = '';
    state.users.forEach(function(u){
        var roleCls = u.role === 'admin' ? 'admin' : 'user';
        var roleLbl = u.role === 'admin' ? 'ADMIN' : 'USER';
        var canEdit = state.is_admin;
        var canDelete = state.is_admin && u.id !== state.current_user_id;
        var empName = u.employee_id
            ? ((state.employees.find(function(e){return e.id===u.employee_id;})||{}).name || u.employee_id)
            : '';
        html += '<div class="settings-user' + (u.is_active ? '' : ' inactive') + '" data-id="' + u.id + '">'
            + '<div class="su-main">'
            +   '<div class="su-name">' + esc(u.display_name || u.username)
            +     (u.is_active ? '' : ' <span style="color:#e74c3c;font-size:0.75rem;">(отключён)</span>')
            +   '</div>'
            +   '<div class="su-sub">Логин: <b>' + esc(u.username) + '</b>'
            +     (empName ? ' · Сотрудник: ' + esc(empName) : '')
            +     (u.last_login ? ' · Последний вход: ' + esc(u.last_login) : '')
            +   '</div>'
            + '</div>'
            + '<span class="su-role ' + roleCls + '">' + roleLbl + '</span>'
            + (canEdit ? '<button class="dict-action-btn" data-act="edit" title="Редактировать">✏️</button>' : '')
            + (canDelete ? '<button class="dict-action-btn danger" data-act="delete" title="Удалить">🗑</button>' : '')
            + '</div>';
    });
    wrap.innerHTML = html;
    wrap.querySelectorAll('.settings-user').forEach(function(row){
        var id = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-id'), 10);
        var eb = row.querySelector('[data-act="edit"]');
        var db = row.querySelector('[data-act="delete"]');
        if (eb) eb.addEventListener('click', function(){
            var u = state.users.find(function(x){ return x.id === id; });
            if (u) openUserModal(u);
        });
        if (db) db.addEventListener('click', function(){ deleteUser(id); });
    });
}

function renderPermsTree(selected){
    var tree = $('permsTree'); if (!tree) return;
    selected = selected || {};
    var defaults = (state.default_user || []);
    var html = '';
    (state.permission_groups || []).forEach(function(grp){
        html += '<div class="perms-group">'
             +  '<div class="perms-group-title">' + esc(grp.title) + '</div>'
             +  '<div class="perms-list">';
        grp.items.forEach(function(it){
            var v;
            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(selected, it.key)) {
                v = !!selected[it.key];
            } else {
                v = defaults.indexOf(it.key) !== -1;
            }
            var checked = v ? ' checked' : '';
            html += '<label class="perms-item">'
                 +  '<input type="checkbox" data-perm="' + esc(it.key) + '"' + checked + '>'
                 +  '<span>' + esc(it.label) + '</span>'
                 +  '</label>';
        });
        html += '</div></div>';
    });
    tree.innerHTML = html;
}

function openUserModal(u){
    u = u || null;
    $('userModalTitle').textContent = u ? ('Пользователь: ' + u.username) : 'Новый пользователь';
    $('user_id').value = u ? u.id : '';
    $('user_username').value = u ? u.username : '';
    $('user_kody').value = '';
    $('pwd_hint').textContent = u ? '(оставьте пустым — не менять)' : '(обязательно)';
    $('user_display_name').value = u ? (u.display_name || '') : '';
    $('user_role').value = u ? u.role : 'user';
    $('user_is_active').checked = u ? u.is_active : true;
    $('user_username').disabled = !!u;

    var sel = $('user_employee');
    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— не привязан —</option>';
    state.employees.forEach(function(e){
        var opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = e.id;
        opt.textContent = e.name + (e.fired ? ' 🚪' : '');
        sel.appendChild(opt);
    });
    sel.value = u ? (u.employee_id || '') : '';

    renderPermsTree(u ? u.permissions : {});
    syncRoleUI();
    $('userModal').classList.add('active');
}

function syncRoleUI(){
    var role = $('user_role').value;
    $('permsWrap').style.display = (role === 'admin') ? 'none' : '';
}

$('user_role').addEventListener('change', syncRoleUI);

function collectPerms(){
    var out = {};
    $('permsTree').querySelectorAll('input[data-perm]').forEach(function(cb){
        out[cb.getAttribute('data-perm')] = cb.checked;
    });
    return out;
}

function saveUser(){
    var payload = {
        id: $('user_id').value ? parseInt($('user_id').value, 10) : null,
        username: $('user_username').value.trim(),
        kody: $('user_kody').value,
        display_name: $('user_display_name').value.trim(),
        role: $('user_role').value,
        employee_id: $('user_employee').value || '',
        is_active: $('user_is_active').checked,
        permissions: collectPerms(),
    };
    if (!payload.username) { notify('❌ Укажите логин', 'error'); return; }
    if (!payload.id && !payload.kody) { notify('❌ Укажите parol для нового пользователя', 'error'); return; }
    api('/api/settings/users/save', {
        method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    }).then(function(d){
        if (!d.success) throw new Error(d.error || 'Ошибка');
        notify('✅ Сохранено', 'success');
        $('userModal').classList.remove('active');
        return loadUsers();
    }).catch(function(e){ notify('❌ ' + e.message, 'error'); });
}

function deleteUser(id){
    var u = state.users.find(function(x){ return x.id === id; });
    if (!u) return;
    if (!confirm('Удалить пользователя «' + u.username + '»?\n\nДействие необратимо.')) return;
    api('/api/settings/users/delete', {
        method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: id }),
    }).then(function(d){
        if (!d.success) throw new Error(d.error || 'Ошибка');
        notify('✅ Удалено', 'success');
        return loadUsers();
    }).catch(function(e){ notify('❌ ' + e.message, 'error'); });
}

function loadHolidays(){
    return api('/api/tracker/state').then(function(d){
        state.holidays = d.holidays || {};
        renderHolidays();
    }).catch(function(e){ notify('❌ ' + e.message, 'error'); });
}
function renderHolidays(){
    var wrap = $('holidaysList'); if (!wrap) return;
    var keys = Object.keys(state.holidays || {}).sort();
    if (!keys.length) { wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="dict-empty">Нет праздников</div>'; return; }
    var html = '';
    keys.forEach(function(k){
        html += '<div class="settings-user" data-date="' + esc(k) + '">'
            + '<div class="su-main"><div class="su-name">🎉 ' + esc(state.holidays[k]) + '</div>'
            + '<div class="su-sub">' + esc(k) + '</div></div>'
            + (state.is_admin ? '<button class="dict-action-btn danger" data-act="del">🗑</button>' : '')
            + '</div>';
    });
    wrap.innerHTML = html;
    wrap.querySelectorAll('[data-act="del"]').forEach(function(b){
        b.addEventListener('click', function(){
            var dk = this.closest('.settings-user').getAttribute('data-date');
            if (!confirm('Удалить праздник ' + dk + '?')) return;
            api('/api/tracker/holiday/delete', {
                method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({ date: dk })
            }).then(function(){ loadHolidays(); });
        });
    });
}
$('holAddBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    var dk = $('hol_date').value, name = $('hol_name').value.trim();
    if (!dk) { notify('❌ Укажите дату', 'error'); return; }
    if (!name) name = 'Праздник';
    api('/api/tracker/holiday/save', {
        method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({ date: dk, name: name })
    }).then(function(){
        notify('✅ Сохранено', 'success');
        $('hol_name').value = '';
        loadHolidays();
    }).catch(function(e){ notify('❌ ' + e.message, 'error'); });
});

function loadDbInfo(){
    api('/api/settings/db_info').then(function(d){
        var info = $('db_info_block');
        if (info) {
            var sizeTxt = d.db_size != null ? (Math.round(d.db_size / 1024) + ' KB') : '—';
            info.innerHTML = '<div><b>Путь:</b> <code>' + esc(d.db_path) + '</code></div>'
                + '<div><b>Размер:</b> ' + sizeTxt + '</div>'
                + '<div><b>Сервер:</b> ' + esc(d.host) + ':' + esc(String(d.port)) + '</div>';
        }
        var inp = $('db_path_input');
        if (inp) inp.value = d.db_path || '';
    }).catch(function(e){
        var info = $('db_info_block');
        if (info) info.textContent = '❌ ' + e.message;
    });
    api('/api/settings/plugins').then(function(d){
        var el = $('plugins_list');
        if (!el) return;
        var plugins = d.plugins || [];
        if (!plugins.length) { el.innerHTML = '<i>Плагины не загружены</i>'; return; }
        el.innerHTML = plugins.map(function(p){
            var mark = p.enabled ? '' : ' <span style="color:#e74c3c;">(отключён)</span>';
            return '<div>📦 <b>' + esc(p.name) + '</b> v' + esc(p.version)
                + (p.description ? ' — ' + esc(p.description) : '') + mark + '</div>';
        }).join('');
    }).catch(function(){});
}
$('dbPathSaveBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    var p = $('db_path_input').value.trim();
    if (!p) { notify('❌ Укажите путь', 'error'); return; }
    if (!confirm('Сохранить новый путь к БД?\n\nИзменения применятся после перезапуска сервера.')) return;
    api('/api/settings/db_path/save', {
        method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({ db_path: p })
    }).then(function(d){
        if (!d.success) throw new Error(d.error || 'Ошибка');
        notify('✅ Сохранено. Перезапустите сервер.', 'success');
        loadDbInfo();
    }).catch(function(e){ notify('❌ ' + e.message, 'error'); });
});

function loadPluginsManager(){
    var wrap = $('pluginsManagerList');
    if (wrap) wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="dict-empty">Загрузка...</div>';
    return api('/api/settings/plugins').then(function(d){
        if (!d.success) throw new Error(d.error || 'Ошибка');
        renderPluginsManager(d.plugins || []);
    }).catch(function(e){
        if (wrap) wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="dict-empty" style="color:#e74c3c;">' + esc(e.message || 'Ошибка') + '</div>';
    });
}

function renderPluginsManager(plugins){
    var wrap = $('pluginsManagerList');
    if (!wrap) return;
    if (!plugins.length) {
        wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="dict-empty">В папке plugins/ нет ни одного .py-плагина</div>';
        return;
    }
    var canToggle = !!state.is_admin;
    var html = '';
    plugins.forEach(function(p){
        var stateCls = p.enabled ? 'on' : 'off';
        var loadedMark = p.loaded ? '' : ' <span class="plug-not-loaded">не загружен</span>';
        html += '<div class="plugin-card ' + stateCls + '" data-name="' + esc(p.name) + '">'
            + '<div class="plugin-main">'
            +   '<div class="plugin-name">'
            +     '<span class="plugin-icon">🧩</span>'
            +     '<b>' + esc(p.name) + '</b>'
            +     ' <span class="plugin-ver">v' + esc(p.version || '—') + '</span>'
            +     loadedMark
            +   '</div>'
            +   (p.description ? '<div class="plugin-desc">' + esc(p.description) + '</div>' : '')
            +   (p.updated_at ? '<div class="plugin-meta">изменён: ' + esc(p.updated_at) + '</div>' : '')
            + '</div>'
            + '<label class="plugin-switch" title="' + (canToggle ? 'Вкл/выкл' : 'Только для админа') + '">'
            +   '<input type="checkbox" ' + (p.enabled ? 'checked' : '') + (canToggle ? '' : ' disabled') + ' data-plug="' + esc(p.name) + '">'
            +   '<span class="plugin-switch-track"><span class="plugin-switch-knob"></span></span>'
            + '</label>'
            + '</div>';
    });
    wrap.innerHTML = html;
    wrap.querySelectorAll('input[data-plug]').forEach(function(cb){
        cb.addEventListener('change', function(){
            var name = this.getAttribute('data-plug');
            var enabled = this.checked;
            var self = this;
            api('/api/settings/plugins/toggle', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({name: name, enabled: enabled}),
            }).then(function(d){
                if (!d.success) throw new Error(d.error || 'Ошибка');
                notify('✅ ' + (enabled ? 'Включён' : 'Отключён') + ': ' + name + ' — перезапустите сервер', 'success');
                var card = self.closest('.plugin-card');
                if (card) {
                    card.classList.toggle('on', enabled);
                    card.classList.toggle('off', !enabled);
                }
            }).catch(function(e){
                self.checked = !enabled;
                notify('❌ ' + (e.message || 'Ошибка'), 'error');
            });
        });
    });
}

function loadAudit(){    var kind = $('auditKindFilter') ? $('auditKindFilter').value : '';
    var url = '/api/settings/audit?limit=500';
    if (kind) url += '&kind=' + encodeURIComponent(kind);
    api(url).then(function(d){
        renderAuditV2(d.items || []);
    }).catch(function(e){
        var wrap = $('auditList');
        if (wrap) wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="dict-empty" style="color:#e74c3c;">❌ ' + esc(e.message || 'Ошибка') + '</div>';
    });
}

var AUDIT_KIND = {
    create: { icon: '➕', label: 'Создание', cls: 'k-create' },
    update: { icon: '✏️', label: 'Изменение', cls: 'k-update' },
    delete: { icon: '🗑', label: 'Удаление', cls: 'k-delete' },
    login:  { icon: '🔑', label: 'Вход',     cls: 'k-login'  }
};
var AUDIT_ENTITY = {
    employee:   'Сотрудник',
    task:       'Задача',
    user:       'Пользователь',
    department: 'Отдел',
    team:       'Команда',
    holiday:    'Праздник',
    log:        'Отметка',
    log_copy:   'Копирование дня',
    log_clear:  'Очистка дня',
    config:     'Настройки',
    vacation:   'Отсутствие',
    plugin:     'Плагин'
};
var AUDIT_WD = ['вс','пн','вт','ср','чт','пт','сб'];

function _auditDayKey(ts){
    return (ts || '').slice(0, 10);
}
function _auditTimePart(ts){
    var t = (ts || '').split(' ');
    return t.length > 1 ? t[1] : '';
}
function _auditDayHuman(iso){
    try {
        var p = iso.split('-');
        var y = parseInt(p[0],10), m = parseInt(p[1],10), d = parseInt(p[2],10);
        var dt = new Date(y, m-1, d);
        return String(d).padStart(2,'0') + '.' + String(m).padStart(2,'0') + '.' + y +
            ' · ' + AUDIT_WD[dt.getDay()];
    } catch(e) { return iso; }
}
function _auditDetails(item){
    var raw = item.details || '';
    if (!raw) return null;
    try { var o = JSON.parse(raw); return (o && typeof o === 'object' && !Array.isArray(o)) ? o : null; }
    catch(e) { return null; }
}
function _auditSummary(item){
    var ent = AUDIT_ENTITY[item.entity] || item.entity || '';
    var eid = item.entity_id || '';
    var label = (AUDIT_KIND[item.kind] || {}).label || item.kind || '';
    return {
        action: label,
        entityLabel: ent ? (ent + (eid ? ' · ' + eid : '')) : ''
    };
}
function renderAuditV2(items){
    var wrap = $('auditList');
    if (!wrap) return;
    if (!items.length) {
        wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="dict-empty">Нет событий за выбранный фильтр</div>';
        return;
    }
    var groups = {};
    var order = [];
    items.forEach(function(it){
        var dk = _auditDayKey(it.ts);
        if (!groups[dk]) { groups[dk] = []; order.push(dk); }
        groups[dk].push(it);
    });
    order.sort(function(a,b){ return b.localeCompare(a); });
    var html = '';
    order.forEach(function(dk){
        var arr = groups[dk];
        html += '<div class="audit-day-group">';
        html += '<div class="audit-day-head">'
              +   '<span class="audit-day-date">' + esc(_auditDayHuman(dk)) + '</span>'
              +   '<span class="audit-day-count">' + arr.length + ' ' + (arr.length === 1 ? 'событие' : (arr.length < 5 ? 'события' : 'событий')) + '</span>'
              + '</div>';
        html += '<div class="audit-day-items">';
        arr.forEach(function(it){
            var k = AUDIT_KIND[it.kind] || { icon: '•', label: it.kind, cls: 'k-other' };
            var sum = _auditSummary(it);
            var det = _auditDetails(it);
            var detHtml = '';
            if (det) {
                detHtml = '<div class="audit-details" hidden>'
                    + '<table class="audit-details-table">'
                    + Object.keys(det).map(function(key){
                        var v = det[key];
                        if (v == null) v = '';
                        if (typeof v === 'object') v = JSON.stringify(v, null, 0);
                        return '<tr><td class="ad-key">' + esc(key) + '</td>'
                             + '<td class="ad-val">' + esc(String(v)) + '</td></tr>';
                    }).join('')
                    + '</table></div>';
                }
            html += '<div class="audit-row ' + k.cls + (det ? ' expandable' : '') + '" data-id="' + (it.id || '') + '">'
                  +   '<span class="audit-kind-icon ' + k.cls + '" title="' + esc(k.label) + '">' + k.icon + '</span>'
                  +   '<div class="audit-main">'
                  +     '<div class="audit-line1">'
                  +       '<span class="audit-user">' + esc(it.username || '—') + '</span>'
                  +       '<span class="audit-sep">·</span>'
                  +       '<span class="audit-action">' + esc(sum.action) + '</span>'
                  +       (sum.entityLabel ? '<span class="audit-entity">' + esc(sum.entityLabel) + '</span>' : '')
                  +     '</div>'
                  +     '<div class="audit-line2">'
                  +       '<span class="audit-time">' + esc(_auditTimePart(it.ts || '')) + '</span>'
                  +     '</div>'
                  +   '</div>'
                  +   (det ? '<span class="audit-expand">▾</span>' : '')
                  + '</div>'
                  + detHtml;
        });
        html += '</div></div>';
    });
    wrap.innerHTML = html;
    wrap.querySelectorAll('.audit-row.expandable').forEach(function(row){
        row.addEventListener('click', function(){
            var det = this.nextElementSibling;
            if (!det || !det.classList.contains('audit-details')) return;
            var hidden = det.hasAttribute('hidden');
            if (hidden) det.removeAttribute('hidden');
            else det.setAttribute('hidden', '');
            this.classList.toggle('expanded', hidden);
        });
    });
}$('auditRefreshBtn').addEventListener('click', loadAudit);if ($('pluginsRefreshBtn')) $('pluginsRefreshBtn').addEventListener('click', loadPluginsManager);
$('auditKindFilter').addEventListener('change', loadAudit);

/* ============================================================
   PATCH 2026-10-06 — Админка: enhancement (аватары, KPI)
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
    'use strict';

    function initialsFromText(text) {
        var clean = String(text || '').replace(/\(отключён\)/g, '').replace(/[\*]+/g, '').trim();
        var parts = clean.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        if (!parts.length) return '?';
        var s = (parts[0][0] || '?');
        if (parts[1] && parts[1][0]) s += parts[1][0];
        return s.toUpperCase();
    }

    function enhanceUsers(list) {
        if (!list) return;

        list.querySelectorAll('.settings-user').forEach(function(row){
            if (row.querySelector('.su-avatar')) return;
            var nameEl = row.querySelector('.su-name');
            var txt = nameEl ? nameEl.textContent : '';
            var av = document.createElement('div');
            av.className = 'su-avatar';
            av.textContent = initialsFromText(txt);
            row.insertBefore(av, row.firstChild);
        });

        var all = list.querySelectorAll('.settings-user').length;
        var active = list.querySelectorAll('.settings-user:not(.inactive)').length;
        var admins = list.querySelectorAll('.settings-user .su-role.admin').length;

        var parent = list.parentNode;
        var kpi = parent ? parent.querySelector('.su-kpi') : null;
        if (!kpi && parent) {
            kpi = document.createElement('div');
            kpi.className = 'su-kpi';
            parent.insertBefore(kpi, list);
        }
        if (!kpi) return;
        kpi.innerHTML =
            '<div class="su-kpi-card"><div class="su-kpi-value">' + all + '</div><div class="su-kpi-label">Всего</div></div>'
          + '<div class="su-kpi-card"><div class="su-kpi-value">' + active + '</div><div class="su-kpi-label">Активных</div></div>'
          + '<div class="su-kpi-card"><div class="su-kpi-value">' + admins + '</div><div class="su-kpi-label">Админов</div></div>';
    }

    function hook(list) {
        var obs = new MutationObserver(function(){ enhanceUsers(list); });
        obs.observe(list, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        enhanceUsers(list);
    }

    function boot() {
        var list = document.getElementById('usersList');
        if (list) { hook(list); return; }
        var rootObs = new MutationObserver(function(){
            var t = document.getElementById('usersList');
            if (t) { rootObs.disconnect(); hook(t); }
        });
        rootObs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    } else {
        boot();
    }
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 2026-10-06 — Пользователи: клик по карточке = редактирование
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
    'use strict';

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        var card = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('#usersList .settings-user');
        if (!card) return;
        if (e.target.closest('.dict-action-btn[data-act="delete"]')) return;
        if (e.target.closest('a, input, select, textarea')) return;
        var id = parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-id'), 10);
        if (!id) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        // PATCH v1.0.4: прямой вызов openUserModal вместо click по скрытой кнопке
        var _users = (typeof window.__trkGetUsersState === 'function') ? window.__trkGetUsersState() : null;
        var _u = _users ? _users.find(function(x){ return x.id === id; }) : null;
        if (_u && typeof window.__trkOpenUserModal === 'function') {
            window.__trkOpenUserModal(_u);
        } else {
            var editBtn = card.querySelector('.dict-action-btn[data-act="edit"]');
            if (editBtn) editBtn.click();
        }
    }, true);

    function mark() {
        var wrap = document.getElementById('usersList');
        if (!wrap) return;
        wrap.querySelectorAll('.settings-user').forEach(function(card){
            if (card.querySelector('.dict-action-btn[data-act="edit"]')) {
                card.classList.add('su-clickable');
            } else {
                card.classList.remove('su-clickable');
            }
        });
    }

    function attachObserver() {
        var wrap = document.getElementById('usersList');
        if (!wrap || wrap._suClickObserver) return;
        wrap._suClickObserver = new MutationObserver(mark);
        wrap._suClickObserver.observe(wrap, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        mark();
    }

    function boot() {
        attachObserver();
        setTimeout(attachObserver, 800);
        setTimeout(mark, 1500);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    } else {
        boot();
    }
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 32 — Резервные копии БД в админке
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
    'use strict';
    function _fmtSize(n){
        n = Number(n) || 0;
        if (n < 1024) return n + ' Б';
        if (n < 1024*1024) return Math.round(n/1024) + ' КБ';
        return (n/1024/1024).toFixed(2) + ' МБ';
    }
    function renderList(items){
        var wrap = document.getElementById('dbBackupList');
        if (!wrap) return;
        if (!items || !items.length) {
            wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="dict-empty">Бэкапов пока нет</div>';
            return;
        }
        wrap.innerHTML = items.map(function(it){
            return '<div class="db-backup-row">'
                 + '<span class="db-backup-name">' + it.name + '</span>'
                 + '<span class="db-backup-meta">' + it.mtime + ' · ' + _fmtSize(it.size) + '</span>'
                 + '<a class="db-backup-dl" href="/api/settings/db_backup/download?name=' + encodeURIComponent(it.name) + '" download>⬇ Скачать</a>'
                 + '</div>';
        }).join('');
    }
    function loadList(){
        var csrf = window.REESTR_CSRF || '';
        fetch('/api/settings/db_backup/list', {
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            headers: csrf ? {'X-CSRF-Token': csrf} : {}
        }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); }).then(function(d){
            if (d && d.success) renderList(d.items || []);
        }).catch(function(){});
    }
    function createNow(){
        var csrf = window.REESTR_CSRF || '';
        var btn = document.getElementById('dbBackupNowBtn');
        if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
        fetch('/api/settings/db_backup', {
            method: 'POST',
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            headers: Object.assign({'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, csrf ? {'X-CSRF-Token': csrf} : {})
        }).then(function(r){ return r.json().then(function(j){ return {ok: r.ok, d: j}; }); })
        .then(function(res){
            if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
            if (res.ok && res.d && res.d.success) {
                if (typeof notify === 'function') notify('✅ Бэкап создан', 'success');
                loadList();
            } else {
                if (typeof notify === 'function') notify('❌ ' + ((res.d && res.d.error) || 'Ошибка'), 'error');
            }
        }).catch(function(e){
            if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
            if (typeof notify === 'function') notify('❌ ' + (e.message || 'Ошибка'), 'error');
        });
    }
    function boot(){
        var b = document.getElementById('dbBackupNowBtn');
        if (b && !b._bkHooked) {
            b._bkHooked = true;
            b.addEventListener('click', createNow);
        }
        var r = document.getElementById('dbBackupRefreshBtn');
        if (r && !r._bkHooked) {
            r._bkHooked = true;
            r.addEventListener('click', loadList);
        }
        loadList();
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        if (e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.settings-tab[data-tab="db"]')) {
            setTimeout(boot, 200);
        }
    });
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){ setTimeout(boot, 500); });
    else setTimeout(boot, 500);
})();

/* ============================================================
   PATCH v1.0.16 — надёжные клики в админке пользователей
   Дубль-страховка: если v1.0.4-обработчик не сработал,

if (window.__trkUsersClickHardening) return;

function _findUser(id) {
    var get = window.__trkGetUsersState;
    var users = (typeof get === 'function') ? (get() || []) : [];
    for (var i = 0; i < users.length; i++) {
        if (users[i] && users[i].id === id) return users[i];
    }
    return null;
}

function _openUserModal(u) {
    var open = window.__trkOpenUserModal;
    if (typeof open !== 'function') {
        console.error('[users-hardening] __trkOpenUserModal не определён');
        return false;
    }
    try { open(u); return true; } catch (e) {
        console.error('[users-hardening] openUserModal упал:', e);
        return false;
    }
}

function _deleteUser(id) {
    var del = window.__trkDeleteUser;
    if (typeof del !== 'function') {
        console.error('[users-hardening] __trkDeleteUser не определён');
        return false;
    }
    try { del(id); return true; } catch (e) {
        console.error('[users-hardening] deleteUser упал:', e);
        return false;
    }
}

function _isUserModalOpen() {
    var m = document.getElementById('userModal');
    return !!(m && m.classList.contains('active'));
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;

    // 1) Кнопка «Добавить пользователя»
    if (e.target.closest('#addUserBtn')) {
        if (_isUserModalOpen()) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        _openUserModal(null);
        return;
    }

    // 2) Кнопка «Удалить» на карточке
    var delBtn = e.target.closest('#usersList .settings-user .dict-action-btn[data-act=\"delete\"]');
    if (delBtn) {
        var row = delBtn.closest('.settings-user');
        var id = row ? parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-id'), 10) : 0;
        if (!id) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        _deleteUser(id);
        return;
    }

    // 3) Клик по карточке (не по кнопке удаления, не по inputs)
    var card = e.target.closest('#usersList .settings-user');
    if (card) {
        if (e.target.closest('a, input, select, textarea')) return;
        if (e.target.closest('button:not([data-act=\"edit\"])')) return;
        var id2 = parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-id'), 10);
        if (!id2) return;
        if (_isUserModalOpen()) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        var u = _findUser(id2);
        if (u) _openUserModal(u);
        return;
    }
}, true);

})();


/* ============================================================
   PATCH v1.0.27 — предупреждение при смене пути к БД
   Если сервер вернул 409 (в новом файле уже есть данные),
   спрашиваем про перезапись и повторяем с force_empty=true.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
'use strict';
if (window.__trkDbPathV127) return;
window.__trkDbPathV127 = true;

var _orig = window.fetch;
if (typeof _orig !== 'function') return;

window.fetch = function(url, opts) {
    var isDbPathSave = (typeof url === 'string' && url.indexOf('/api/settings/db_path/save') !== -1);
    if (!isDbPathSave || !opts || (opts.method || 'GET').toUpperCase() !== 'POST') {
        return _orig.apply(this, arguments);
    }
    var self = this;
    return _orig.apply(this, arguments).then(function(r){
        if (r.status !== 409) return r;
        return r.clone().json().then(function(d){
            if (!d || !d.exists_with_data) return r;
            var ok = confirm(
                'По новому пути уже лежит БД с данными (' + (d.users_count||0) + ' пользователей).\n\n' +
                'Перезаписать её текущей базой?\n' +
                '(Старая база по новому пути будет потеряна.)'
            );
            if (!ok) {
                return new Response(JSON.stringify({success:false, error:'cancelled'}), {
                    status: 200, headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}
                });
            }
            var payload;
            try { payload = JSON.parse(opts.body || '{}'); } catch(e) { payload = {}; }
            payload.force_empty = true;
            payload.copy_data = true;
            var newOpts = Object.assign({}, opts, { body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
            return _orig.call(self, url, newOpts);
        });
    });
};
})();

"""plugins/stats_teams.py — Статистика: Отделы (верхний уровень) + Команды (как раньше)."""

__version__ = '4.0'
__description__ = 'Статистика: KPI отделов + команд, radar, лидерборд, тренды, топ-сотрудники'

from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from flask import request, jsonify, Response, redirect


# ============================================================
# Утилиты
# ============================================================
def _parse_iso(s):
    try:
        return datetime.strptime(s, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
    except Exception:
        return None


def _iso(d):
    return d.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')


def _period_from_args():
    preset = (request.args.get('preset') or 'month').strip().lower()
    today = date.today()
    if preset == 'week':
        monday = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())
        return monday, today, 'week'
    if preset == 'month':
        return today.replace(day=1), today, 'month'
    if preset == 'prev_month':
        first_cur = today.replace(day=1)
        last_prev = first_cur - timedelta(days=1)
        return last_prev.replace(day=1), last_prev, 'prev_month'
    if preset == 'quarter':
        m = (today.month - 1) // 3 * 3 + 1
        return today.replace(month=m, day=1), today, 'quarter'
    d1 = _parse_iso(request.args.get('from') or '')
    d2 = _parse_iso(request.args.get('to') or '')
    if d1 and d2 and d1 <= d2:
        return d1, d2, 'custom'
    return today.replace(day=1), today, 'month'


def _prev_period(d1, d2):
    span = (d2 - d1).days + 1
    return d1 - timedelta(days=span), d1 - timedelta(days=1)


def _workdays_between(d1, d2):
    n = 0
    cur = d1
    while cur <= d2:
        if cur.weekday() < 5:
            n += 1
        cur += timedelta(days=1)
    return n


def _emp_stats(data, emp_ids, d1, d2):
    today = _iso(date.today())
    logs = data.get('log', [])
    all_assignees = {}
    for t in data.get('tasks', []):
        for a in (t.get('assignees') or []):
            all_assignees.setdefault(a, []).append(t)

    # PATCH v1.0.5: предвычисляем last_done по (employee, task) за один проход.
    # Раньше был O(E*T*N) — теперь O(N + E*T).
    last_done_map = {}
    for l in logs:
        if l.get('status') != 'done':
            continue
        eid = l.get('employee_id')
        tid = l.get('task_id')
        d = l.get('date') or ''
        if not eid or not tid or not d:
            continue
        key = (eid, tid)
        cur = last_done_map.get(key)
        if not cur or d > cur:
            last_done_map[key] = d

    per = {}
    for eid in emp_ids:
        per[eid] = {'hours': 0.0, 'tasks_done': 0, 'logs_count': 0,
                    'active_days': set(), 'overdue_tasks': [], 'done_task_ids': set()}

    for l in logs:
        ld = l.get('date') or ''
        if ld < _iso(d1) or ld > _iso(d2):
            continue
        eid = l.get('employee_id')
        if eid not in per:
            continue
        per[eid]['logs_count'] += 1
        try:
            h = float(l.get('hours') or 0)
        except Exception:
            h = 0
        per[eid]['hours'] += h
        per[eid]['active_days'].add(ld)
        tid = l.get('task_id')
        if tid and l.get('status') == 'done':
            per[eid]['done_task_ids'].add(tid)

    for eid, st in per.items():
        st['hours'] = round(st['hours'] * 4) / 4
        st['tasks_done'] = len(st['done_task_ids'])
        st['active_days'] = len(st['active_days'])
        overdue = []
        for t in all_assignees.get(eid, []):
            if t.get('status') not in ('active', 'paused'):
                continue
            dl = t.get('deadline') or ''
            if not dl or dl >= today:
                continue
            if last_done_map.get((eid, t['id'])):
                continue
            overdue.append(t)
        st['overdue_tasks'] = overdue
        st['overdue_count'] = len(overdue)

    return per


def _compute_extras(data, emp_ids, d1, d2):
    from datetime import datetime as _dt
    tasks = {t['id']: t for t in data.get('tasks', [])}
    logs = data.get('log', [])
    start_iso = _iso(d1)
    end_iso = _iso(d2)

    on_time = 0
    late = 0
    cycles = []

    for l in logs:
        if l.get('employee_id') not in emp_ids:
            continue
        if l.get('status') != 'done':
            continue
        ld = l.get('date') or ''
        if ld < start_iso or ld > end_iso:
            continue
        t = tasks.get(l.get('task_id'))
        if not t:
            continue
        dl = t.get('deadline') or ''
        if dl:
            if ld <= dl:
                on_time += 1
            else:
                late += 1
        fdate = None
        for l2 in logs:
            if l2.get('task_id') != l.get('task_id'):
                continue
            if l2.get('employee_id') not in emp_ids:
                continue
            d = l2.get('date') or ''
            if not fdate or d < fdate:
                fdate = d
        if fdate and ld >= fdate:
            try:
                delta = (_dt.strptime(ld, '%Y-%m-%d') - _dt.strptime(fdate, '%Y-%m-%d')).days
                cycles.append(delta)
            except Exception:
                pass

    total_done = on_time + late
    on_time_pct = round(100 * on_time / total_done) if total_done else 0
    cycle_avg = round(sum(cycles) / len(cycles), 1) if cycles else 0

    trend = []
    end = d2
    for w in range(4):
        w_end = end - timedelta(days=7 * w)
        w_start = w_end - timedelta(days=6)
        if w_start < d1 - timedelta(days=90):
            break
        hours = 0.0
        for l in logs:
            if l.get('employee_id') not in emp_ids:
                continue
            ld = l.get('date') or ''
            if _iso(w_start) <= ld <= _iso(w_end):
                try:
                    hours += float(l.get('hours') or 0)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        trend.append({'from': _iso(w_start), 'to': _iso(w_end), 'hours': round(hours * 4) / 4})
    trend.reverse()

    return {'on_time_pct': on_time_pct, 'cycle_avg_days': cycle_avg, 'trend': trend}


def _aggregate(data, name, emp_ids, d1, d2, prev=None, extra=None):
    """Универсальный агрегатор для команды и отдела."""
    per = _emp_stats(data, emp_ids, d1, d2)
    wd = _workdays_between(d1, d2)
    total_hours = 0.0
    total_done = 0
    total_overdue = 0
    active = 0
    for st in per.values():
        total_hours += st['hours']
        total_done += st['tasks_done']
        total_overdue += st['overdue_count']
        if st['hours'] > 0:
            active += 1
    total_hours = round(total_hours * 4) / 4
    possible_hours = wd * 8 * len(emp_ids)
    coverage = round(100 * total_hours / possible_hours) if possible_hours else 0
    avg_per_emp = round(total_hours / len(emp_ids) * 4) / 4 if emp_ids else 0

    def meta(eid):
        e = next((x for x in data.get('employees', []) if x['id'] == eid), None)
        return {'id': eid, 'name': (e.get('name') if e else eid), 'color': (e.get('color') if e else '#888')}

    ranking_hours = sorted([dict(meta(eid), hours=st['hours']) for eid, st in per.items()], key=lambda x: -x['hours'])[:3]
    ranking_done = sorted([dict(meta(eid), tasks_done=st['tasks_done']) for eid, st in per.items() if st['tasks_done'] > 0], key=lambda x: -x['tasks_done'])[:3]
    ranking_coverage = sorted([dict(meta(eid), coverage=round(100 * st['active_days'] / wd) if wd else 0) for eid, st in per.items()], key=lambda x: -x['coverage'])[:3]

    extras = _compute_extras(data, emp_ids, d1, d2)

    def _delta(cur, prv):
        try:
            cur = float(cur); prv = float(prv)
            if prv == 0:
                return {'abs': round(cur, 2), 'pct': 0 if cur == 0 else 100}
            return {'abs': round(cur - prv, 2), 'pct': round(100 * (cur - prv) / prv)}
        except Exception:
            return {'abs': 0, 'pct': 0}

    deltas = {}
    if prev:
        deltas = {
            'hours': _delta(total_hours, prev.get('total_hours', 0)),
            'done': _delta(total_done, prev.get('total_done', 0)),
            'coverage': _delta(coverage, prev.get('coverage', 0)),
            'overdue': _delta(total_overdue, prev.get('total_overdue', 0)),
        }

    result = {
        'name': name,
        'members_count': len(emp_ids),
        'active_members': active,
        'total_hours': total_hours,
        'total_done': total_done,
        'total_overdue': total_overdue,
        'coverage': coverage,
        'possible_hours': possible_hours,
        'avg_per_emp': avg_per_emp,
        'workdays': wd,
        'top_hours': ranking_hours,
        'top_done': ranking_done,
        'top_coverage': ranking_coverage,
        'extras': extras,
        'deltas': deltas,
        'overdue_tasks': [{'id': t['id'], 'name': t.get('name', ''), 'icon': t.get('icon', '📋'), 'deadline': t.get('deadline', '')} for t in sum([st['overdue_tasks'] for st in per.values()], [])][:10],
    }
    if extra:
        result.update(extra)
    return result

<script>
(function(){
'use strict';

function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];});}
function initials(n){var p=String(n||'').trim().split(/\s+/);if(!p.length)return'?';if(p.length===1)return p[0].slice(0,2).toUpperCase();return (p[0][0]+(p[1][0]||'')).toUpperCase();}
function fmtH(h){h=Number(h)||0;if(h===Math.floor(h))return h+' ч';return h.toFixed(2).replace(/0+$/,'').replace(/\.$/,'')+' ч';}
function fmtI(n){return (Number(n)||0).toLocaleString('ru-RU');}
function fmtPct(n){return (Number(n)||0)+'%';}
function coverCls(n){n=Number(n)||0;if(n>=70)return'ok';if(n>=40)return'warn';return'err';}
function fmtDate(iso){if(!iso)return'';var p=iso.split('-');if(p.length!==3)return iso;return p[2]+'.'+p[1]+'.'+p[0];}

var state = { preset:'month', from:'', to:'', deptFilter:'' };
var DATA = null;

function renderKpis(s){
    var el = document.getElementById('kpis');
    var cards = [
        { v: fmtI(s.depts_count), l: 'Отделов', cls: '' },
        { v: fmtI(s.teams_count), l: 'Команд', cls: '' },
        { v: fmtH(s.hours_total), l: 'Часов всего', cls: '' },
        { v: fmtI(s.tasks_done), l: 'Задач закрыто', cls: 'ok' },
        { v: fmtI(s.tasks_overdue), l: 'Просрочено', cls: 'danger' },
        { v: fmtPct(s.coverage), l: 'Покрытие', cls: s.coverage >= 70 ? 'ok' : (s.coverage >= 40 ? 'warn' : 'danger') },
        { v: fmtI(s.active_employees)+' / '+fmtI(s.employees_total), l: 'Активных / Всего', cls: 'info' }
    ];
    el.innerHTML = cards.map(function(c){ return '<div class="kpi '+c.cls+'"><div class="v">'+c.v+'</div><div class="l">'+c.l+'</div></div>'; }).join('');
}

/* Bar chart */
function renderBars(elId, items, opts) {
    var el = document.getElementById(elId);
    if (!el) return;
    if (!items || !items.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Нет данных</div>'; return; }
    opts = opts || {};
    var maxV = Math.max.apply(null, items.map(function(x){return x.value;}).concat([1]));
    var colorFn = opts.colorFn || function(){ return '#f5d76e'; };
    var fmtFn = opts.fmtFn || function(v){ return v; };
    var rowsH = 30;
    var W = 560, H = items.length * rowsH + 6;
    var padL = 170, padR = 100, padT = 4;
    var innerW = W - padL - padR;
    var html = '<svg viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" style="max-height:'+Math.max(160,H)+'px;">';
    items.forEach(function(it, i){
        var bw = Math.max(2, (it.value / maxV) * innerW);
        var y = padT + i * rowsH;
        var color = colorFn(it);
        var nameShort = it.name.length > 26 ? it.name.slice(0, 24) + '…' : it.name;
        html += '<text x="'+(padL-8)+'" y="'+(y+rowsH*0.6)+'" font-size="11" fill="var(--pg-text)" text-anchor="end">'+esc(nameShort)+'</text>';
        html += '<rect x="'+padL+'" y="'+(y+5)+'" width="'+bw+'" height="'+(rowsH-12)+'" fill="'+color+'" rx="3" opacity="0.85"><title>'+esc(it.name)+': '+esc(fmtFn(it.value))+'</title></rect>';
        html += '<text x="'+(padL+bw+6)+'" y="'+(y+rowsH*0.6)+'" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="var(--pg-accent)">'+esc(fmtFn(it.value))+'</text>';
    });
    html += '</svg>';
    el.innerHTML = html;
}

/* Radar */
function renderRadar(elId, legendId, teams, axes) {
    var el = document.getElementById(elId);
    var legend = document.getElementById(legendId);
    if (!el) return;
    if (!teams || teams.length < 2) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Нужно ≥ 2 команды</div>'; if (legend) legend.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    var W = 560, H = 420;
    var cx = W/2, cy = H/2 + 10, R = 145;
    var n = axes.length;
    var norm = {};
    axes.forEach(function(ax){
        var vals = teams.map(function(t){ return Number(ax.get(t)) || 0; });
        norm[ax.key] = { min: Math.min.apply(null, vals), max: Math.max.apply(null, vals), invert: !!ax.invert };
    });
    function point(i, t) {
        var ax = axes[i];
        var v = Number(ax.get(t)) || 0;
        var r = norm[ax.key];
        var pct = (r.max === r.min) ? 1 : (v - r.min) / (r.max - r.min);
        if (r.invert) pct = 1 - pct;
        var rr = 12 + pct * (R - 12);
        var ang = -Math.PI/2 + (i * 2 * Math.PI / n);
        return { x: cx + rr*Math.cos(ang), y: cy + rr*Math.sin(ang) };
    }
    var html = '<svg viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">';
    [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].forEach(function(s){
        var r = 12 + s * (R - 12);
        var pts = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            var ang = -Math.PI/2 + (i * 2 * Math.PI / n);
            pts.push((cx + r*Math.cos(ang)).toFixed(1) + ',' + (cy + r*Math.sin(ang)).toFixed(1));
        }
        html += '<polygon points="'+pts.join(' ')+'" fill="none" stroke="rgba(128,128,128,0.20)" stroke-width="1"/>';
    });
    axes.forEach(function(ax, i){
        var ang = -Math.PI/2 + (i * 2 * Math.PI / n);
        html += '<line x1="'+cx+'" y1="'+cy+'" x2="'+(cx + R*Math.cos(ang)).toFixed(1)+'" y2="'+(cy + R*Math.sin(ang)).toFixed(1)+'" stroke="rgba(128,128,128,0.20)"/>';
        var lx = cx + (R + 24) * Math.cos(ang);
        var ly = cy + (R + 24) * Math.sin(ang);
        var anchor = 'middle';
        if (Math.cos(ang) > 0.3) anchor = 'start';
        else if (Math.cos(ang) < -0.3) anchor = 'end';
        html += '<text x="'+lx.toFixed(1)+'" y="'+(ly+4).toFixed(1)+'" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="var(--pg-meta)" text-anchor="'+anchor+'">'+esc(ax.label)+'</text>';
    });
    var palette = ['#f5d76e', '#5dade2', '#58d68d', '#ec7063', '#9b59b6', '#f39c12', '#1abc9c', '#e91e63', '#00bcd4', '#8bc34a', '#607d8b', '#ff5722'];
    teams.forEach(function(t, ti){
        var color = palette[ti % palette.length];
        var pts = axes.map(function(_, i){ return point(i, t); });
        var path = pts.map(function(p){ return p.x.toFixed(1) + ',' + p.y.toFixed(1); }).join(' ');
        html += '<polygon points="'+path+'" fill="'+color+'" fill-opacity="0.14" stroke="'+color+'" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>';
        pts.forEach(function(p, i){
            html += '<circle cx="'+p.x.toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+p.y.toFixed(1)+'" r="3" fill="'+color+'"><title>'+esc(t.name)+' · '+esc(axes[i].label)+': '+esc(axes[i].fmt(axes[i].get(t)))+'</title></circle>';
        });
    });
    html += '</svg>';
    el.innerHTML = html;
    if (legend) {
        legend.innerHTML = teams.map(function(t, ti){
            var color = palette[ti % palette.length];
            return '<span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;"><span style="width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;background:'+color+';"></span>'+esc(t.name)+'</span>';
        }).join('');
    }
}

/* Leaderboard (по командам) */
function renderLeaderboard(teams){
    var el = document.getElementById('leaderboard');
    if (!el) return;
    if (!teams || !teams.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Нет команд</div>'; return; }
    function topBy(fn, fmt, cls) {
        return teams.slice().sort(function(a, b){ return fn(b) - fn(a); }).slice(0, 3).map(function(t, i){
            var medal = i === 0 ? '🥇' : (i === 1 ? '🥈' : '🥉');
            return '<div class="lb-row"><span class="lb-medal">'+medal+'</span><span class="lb-name">'+esc(t.name)+'</span><span class="lb-val '+(cls||'')+'">'+fmt(fn(t))+'</span></div>';
        }).join('');
    }
    function bottomBy(fn, fmt, cls) {
        return teams.slice().sort(function(a, b){ return fn(a) - fn(b); }).slice(0, 3).map(function(t, i){
            return '<div class="lb-row"><span class="lb-medal">'+(i+1)+'</span><span class="lb-name">'+esc(t.name)+'</span><span class="lb-val '+(cls||'err')+'">'+fmt(fn(t))+'</span></div>';
        }).join('');
    }
    el.innerHTML = ''
        + '<div class="lb-block"><div class="lb-title">🏆 Больше всего часов</div>'+topBy(function(t){return t.total_hours;}, fmtH)+'</div>'
        + '<div class="lb-block"><div class="lb-title">✅ Больше всего закрыто</div>'+topBy(function(t){return t.total_done;}, function(v){return fmtI(v)+' шт';}, 'ok')+'</div>'
        + '<div class="lb-block"><div class="lb-title">📅 Лучшее покрытие</div>'+topBy(function(t){return t.coverage;}, fmtPct, 'ok')+'</div>'
        + '<div class="lb-block"><div class="lb-title">⚠ Меньше просрочек</div>'+bottomBy(function(t){return t.total_overdue;}, function(v){return fmtI(v);}, 'ok')+'</div>';
}

/* Сводная таблица — универсальная */
function renderCompareTable(elId, rows, opts) {
    var el = document.getElementById(elId);
    if (!el) return;
    if (!rows || !rows.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Нет данных</div>'; return; }
    opts = opts || {};
    var showDept = !!opts.showDept;
    function best(fn, invert) { var vals = rows.map(function(r){ return fn(r) || 0; }); return invert ? Math.min.apply(null, vals) : Math.max.apply(null, vals); }
    var bH = best(function(r){return r.total_hours;});
    var bD = best(function(r){return r.total_done;});
    var bC = best(function(r){return r.coverage;});
    var wC = best(function(r){return r.coverage;}, true);
    var bO = best(function(r){return (r.extras||{}).on_time_pct || 0;});
    var minOv = best(function(r){return r.total_overdue;}, true);
    var maxOv = best(function(r){return r.total_overdue;});
    var html = '<table class="cmp"><thead><tr><th>Название</th>';
    if (showDept) html += '<th>Отдел</th>';
    html += '<th class="num">Часов</th><th class="num">Закрыто</th><th class="num">Покрытие</th><th class="num">В срок</th><th class="num">Просроч.</th><th class="num">Актив.</th><th class="num">Δ часов</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    rows.forEach(function(r){
        var d = r.deltas || {};
        var dHtml = '<td class="num">';
        if (d.hours) {
            var s = d.hours.pct >= 0 ? '+' : '';
            dHtml += '<span class="' + (d.hours.pct >= 0 ? 'delta-up' : 'delta-down') + '">'+s+fmtPct(d.hours.pct)+'</span>';
        } else dHtml += '<span style="opacity:0.4;">—</span>';
        dHtml += '</td>';
        var ex = r.extras || {};
        html += '<tr><td><div class="tm-cell"><span class="tm-dot"></span><span>'+esc(r.name)+'</span></div></td>';
        if (showDept) html += '<td>' + (r.department_name ? '<span class="dept-chip">'+esc(r.department_name)+'</span>' : '<span style="opacity:0.4;">—</span>') + '</td>';
        html += '<td class="num '+(r.total_hours===bH?'best':'')+'">'+fmtH(r.total_hours)+'</td>'
             + '<td class="num '+(r.total_done===bD?'best':'')+'">'+fmtI(r.total_done)+'</td>'
             + '<td class="num '+(r.coverage===bC?'best':(r.coverage===wC?'worst':''))+'">'+fmtPct(r.coverage)+'</td>'
             + '<td class="num '+((ex.on_time_pct||0)===bO?'best':'')+'">'+fmtPct(ex.on_time_pct||0)+'</td>'
             + '<td class="num '+(r.total_overdue===minOv?'best':(r.total_overdue===maxOv?'worst':''))+'">'+fmtI(r.total_overdue)+'</td>'
             + '<td class="num">'+fmtI(r.active_members)+'/'+fmtI(r.members_count)+'</td>'
             + dHtml + '</tr>';
    });
    html += '</tbody></table>';
    el.innerHTML = html;
}

/* Карточки отделов */
function renderDeptCard(d){
    var color = d.department_color || '#f5d76e';
    var cls = coverCls(d.coverage);
    var isFiltered = state.deptFilter === d.department_id ? ' is-filtered' : '';
    var mgr = d.manager_id ? 'Рук.: <b>'+esc(d.manager_id)+'</b>' : '';
    var teamsChips = (d.teams || []).map(function(t){
        return '<span class="team-chip" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--pg-accent-bg);color:var(--pg-accent);font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:700;">'+esc(t.name)+' <span style="color:var(--pg-meta);font-weight:500;">'+fmtH(t.total_hours)+'</span></span>';
    }).join('');
    var html = '<div class="dept-card'+isFiltered+'" style="--dept-color:'+esc(color)+';" data-dept-id="'+esc(d.department_id)+'">'
        + '<div class="dept-head"><div class="dept-name">'+esc(d.name)+'</div>'+(mgr?'<div class="dept-mgr">'+mgr+'</div>':'')+'</div>'
        + '<div class="dept-kpi">'
        + '<div class="kpi-cell"><div class="kpi-v">'+fmtH(d.total_hours)+'</div><div class="kpi-l">Часов</div></div>'
        + '<div class="kpi-cell"><div class="kpi-v">'+fmtI(d.total_done)+'</div><div class="kpi-l">Закрыто</div></div>'
        + '<div class="kpi-cell"><div class="kpi-v" style="color:'+(d.total_overdue?'#ec7063':'#f5d76e')+';">'+fmtI(d.total_overdue)+'</div><div class="kpi-l">Просроч.</div></div>'
        + '</div>'
        + '<div class="cover-bar"><div class="cover-fill '+cls+'" style="width:'+Math.min(d.coverage,100)+'%;"></div></div>'
        + '<div class="cover-info"><span>Покрытие '+fmtPct(d.coverage)+'</span><span>'+fmtH(d.total_hours)+' / '+fmtH(d.possible_hours)+'</span></div>'
        + '<div class="cover-info"><span>Активных: '+fmtI(d.active_members)+' / '+fmtI(d.members_count)+'</span><span>Ср.: '+fmtH(d.avg_per_emp)+'</span></div>'
        + (teamsChips?'<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--pg-inner-bg);border-radius:10px;">'+teamsChips+'</div>':'')
        + '</div>';
    return html;
}

/* Карточки команд (как было в v2) */
function renderTeamCard(t){
    var mgrTxt = t.manager_id ? 'Рук.: <b>'+esc(t.manager_id)+'</b>' : 'Без руководителя';
    var deptChip = t.department_name ? '<span class="dept-chip" style="margin-left:0;margin-right:6px;">'+esc(t.department_name)+'</span>' : '';
    var cls = coverCls(t.coverage);
    var ex = t.extras || {};
    var d = t.deltas || {};
    var html = '<div class="team-head">'+deptChip+'<div class="team-name">'+esc(t.name)+'</div><div class="team-mgr">'+mgrTxt+'</div></div>';
    html += '<div class="team-kpi">'
         + '<div class="kpi-cell"><div class="kpi-v">'+fmtH(t.total_hours)+'</div><div class="kpi-l">Часов</div></div>'
         + '<div class="kpi-cell"><div class="kpi-v">'+fmtI(t.total_done)+'</div><div class="kpi-l">Закрыто</div></div>'
         + '<div class="kpi-cell"><div class="kpi-v" style="color:'+(t.total_overdue?'#ec7063':'#f5d76e')+';">'+fmtI(t.total_overdue)+'</div><div class="kpi-l">Просроч.</div></div>'
         + '</div>';
    html += '<div class="cover-bar"><div class="cover-fill '+cls+'" style="width:'+Math.min(t.coverage,100)+'%;"></div></div>';
    html += '<div class="cover-info"><span>Покрытие '+fmtPct(t.coverage)+'</span><span>'+fmtH(t.total_hours)+' / '+fmtH(t.possible_hours)+'</span></div>';
    html += '<div class="cover-info"><span>Активных: '+fmtI(t.active_members)+' / '+fmtI(t.members_count)+'</span><span>Ср.: '+fmtH(t.avg_per_emp)+'</span></div>';
    html += '<div class="team-kpi" style="grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);">'
         + '<div class="kpi-cell"><div class="kpi-v">'+fmtPct(ex.on_time_pct)+'</div><div class="kpi-l">В срок</div></div>'
         + '<div class="kpi-cell"><div class="kpi-v">'+(ex.cycle_avg_days?ex.cycle_avg_days+' дн':'—')+'</div><div class="kpi-l">Cycle</div></div>'
         + (d.hours ? '<div class="kpi-cell"><div class="kpi-v" style="color:'+(d.hours.pct>=0?'#58d68d':'#ec7063')+';">'+(d.hours.pct>=0?'+':'')+fmtPct(d.hours.pct)+'</div><div class="kpi-l">Δ часов</div></div>' : '<div class="kpi-cell"><div class="kpi-v">—</div><div class="kpi-l">Δ часов</div></div>')
         + '</div>';
    html += renderRank('🏆 Топ по часам', t.top_hours, 'hours');
    html += renderRank('✅ Топ по закрытым', t.top_done, 'done');
    if (t.overdue_tasks && t.overdue_tasks.length) {
        html += '<div class="ov-tasks"><div class="ot-title">⚠ Просроченные задачи</div>';
        t.overdue_tasks.slice(0, 5).forEach(function(ot){
            html += '<div class="ot-row"><span>'+esc(ot.icon||'📋')+' '+esc(ot.name)+'</span><span class="ot-dl">'+fmtDate(ot.deadline)+'</span></div>';
        });
        html += '</div>';
    }
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'team-card';
    card.innerHTML = html;
    return card;
}

function renderRank(title, rows, kind){
    if (!rows || !rows.length) return '';
    var h = '<div class="rank-block"><div class="rank-title">'+title+'</div>';
    rows.forEach(function(r, i){
        var medal = i === 0 ? '🥇' : (i === 1 ? '🥈' : '🥉');
        var val = kind === 'hours' ? fmtH(r.hours) : (kind === 'done' ? fmtI(r.tasks_done)+' шт' : fmtPct(r.coverage));
        h += '<div class="rank-row"><span class="rank-medal">'+medal+'</span><span class="rank-avatar" style="background:'+esc(r.color||'#888')+';">'+esc(initials(r.name))+'</span><span class="rank-name">'+esc(r.name)+'</span><span class="rank-val">'+val+'</span></div>';
    });
    return h + '</div>';
}

function load(){
    var q = '?preset='+encodeURIComponent(state.preset);
    if (state.preset === 'custom') q += '&from='+encodeURIComponent(state.from)+'&to='+encodeURIComponent(state.to);
    fetch('/api/plugins/stats_teams/data'+q, {credentials:'same-origin'})
        .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
        .then(function(d){ if (!d || !d.success) { alert('Ошибка загрузки'); return; } DATA = d; renderAll(); })
        .catch(function(){ alert('Ошибка соединения'); });
}

function renderAll(){
    if (!DATA) return;
    var depts = DATA.departments || [];
    var teams = DATA.teams || [];

    renderKpis(DATA.summary || {});

    // --- Отделы ---
    document.getElementById('deptsCount').textContent = depts.length;
    var sel = document.getElementById('teamDeptFilter');
    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Все отделы</option>';
    depts.forEach(function(d){
        var o = document.createElement('option');
        o.value = d.department_id;
        o.textContent = d.name;
        if (d.department_id === state.deptFilter) o.selected = true;
        sel.appendChild(o);
    });

    renderBars('chartDeptHours', depts.map(function(d){return {name: d.name, value: d.total_hours};}), {
        colorFn: function(it){ return it.value > 0 ? '#f5d76e' : '#607d8b'; }, fmtFn: fmtH
    });
    renderBars('chartDeptCoverage', depts.map(function(d){return {name: d.name, value: d.coverage};}), {
        colorFn: function(it){ return it.value >= 70 ? '#58d68d' : (it.value >= 40 ? '#f7dc6f' : '#ec7063'); }, fmtFn: fmtPct
    });

    var dg = document.getElementById('deptsGrid');
    dg.innerHTML = depts.length ? depts.map(renderDeptCard).join('') : '<div class="empty">Нет отделов</div>';
    dg.querySelectorAll('.dept-card').forEach(function(card){
        card.addEventListener('click', function(){
            var did = this.getAttribute('data-dept-id');
            state.deptFilter = (state.deptFilter === did) ? '' : did;
            document.getElementById('teamDeptFilter').value = state.deptFilter;
            renderAll();
        });
    });

    renderCompareTable('deptTable', depts, { showDept: false });

    // --- Команды ---
    var filtered = state.deptFilter ? teams.filter(function(t){ return t.department_id === state.deptFilter; }) : teams;
    document.getElementById('teamsCount').textContent = filtered.length;

    var axes = [
        { key: 'hours', label: 'Часы', get: function(t){ return t.total_hours; }, fmt: fmtH },
        { key: 'coverage', label: 'Покрытие', get: function(t){ return t.coverage; }, fmt: fmtPct },
        { key: 'on_time', label: 'В срок %', get: function(t){ return (t.extras||{}).on_time_pct || 0; }, fmt: fmtPct },
        { key: 'active', label: 'Активных', get: function(t){ return t.active_members; }, fmt: fmtI },
        { key: 'no_over', label: 'Без просрочек', get: function(t){ return t.total_overdue; }, invert: true, fmt: function(v){ return fmtI(v) + ' просроч.'; } }
    ];
    renderRadar('chartRadar', 'radarLegend', filtered.slice(0, 8), axes);
    renderLeaderboard(filtered);

    renderBars('chartHours', filtered.map(function(t){return {name: t.name, value: t.total_hours};}), {
        colorFn: function(){ return '#f5d76e'; }, fmtFn: fmtH
    });
    renderBars('chartCoverage', filtered.map(function(t){return {name: t.name, value: t.coverage};}), {
        colorFn: function(it){ return it.value >= 70 ? '#58d68d' : (it.value >= 40 ? '#f7dc6f' : '#ec7063'); }, fmtFn: fmtPct
    });
    renderBars('chartDone', filtered.map(function(t){return {name: t.name, value: t.total_done};}), {
        colorFn: function(){ return '#5dade2'; }, fmtFn: function(v){ return fmtI(v)+' шт'; }
    });
    renderBars('chartOverdue', filtered.map(function(t){return {name: t.name, value: t.total_overdue};}), {
        colorFn: function(){ return '#ec7063'; }, fmtFn: function(v){ return fmtI(v)+' шт'; }
    });

    renderCompareTable('compareTable', filtered, { showDept: true });

    var tg = document.getElementById('teamsGrid');
    document.getElementById('teamsDetailsCount').textContent = filtered.length;
    tg.innerHTML = '';
    if (!filtered.length) { tg.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Нет команд по фильтру</div>'; return; }
    filtered.forEach(function(t){ tg.appendChild(renderTeamCard(t)); });
}

document.querySelectorAll('.presets button').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){
        document.querySelectorAll('.presets button').forEach(function(x){ x.classList.remove('active'); });
        this.classList.add('active');
        state.preset = this.getAttribute('data-preset');
        load();
    });
});
document.getElementById('stApply').addEventListener('click', function(){
    var f = document.getElementById('stFrom').value;
    var t = document.getElementById('stTo').value;
    if (!f || !t) return;
    state.preset = 'custom'; state.from = f; state.to = t;
    document.querySelectorAll('.presets button').forEach(function(x){ x.classList.remove('active'); });
    load();
});
document.getElementById('teamDeptFilter').addEventListener('change', function(){
    state.deptFilter = this.value;
    renderAll();
});

load();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>'''


# ============================================================
# Регистрация
# ============================================================
def register(app, db, hooks):
    print('[stats_teams] v' + __version__ + ' · ' + __description__)

    @app.route('/plugins-assets/stats_teams.js', methods=['GET'])
    def _st_js():
        return app.response_class(_JS, mimetype='application/javascript')

    @app.route('/plugins/stats_teams/', methods=['GET'])
    def _st_page():
        try:
            from auth import current_user, user_has
            u = current_user(db)
            if not u:
                return redirect('/login')
            if not (user_has(db, u, 'tab.summary') or user_has(db, u, 'tab.stats')):
                return redirect('/')
        except Exception:
            return redirect('/login')
        return Response(_page_html(), mimetype='text/html')

    @app.route('/api/plugins/stats_teams/data', methods=['GET'])
    def _st_data():
        try:
            from auth import current_user, user_has
            u = current_user(db)
            if not u:
                return jsonify({'success': False, 'error': 'auth'}), 401
            if not (user_has(db, u, 'tab.summary') or user_has(db, u, 'tab.stats')):
                return jsonify({'success': False, 'error': 'forbidden'}), 403
        except Exception:
            return jsonify({'success': False, 'error': 'auth'}), 401

        d1, d2, preset = _period_from_args()
        prev_start, prev_end = _prev_period(d1, d2)
        data = db.load_all()

        all_teams = data.get('teams', [])
        all_depts = data.get('departments', [])
        all_emps = data.get('employees', [])
        depts_by_id = {d['id']: d for d in all_depts}

        # Определяем, к какому отделу относится каждая команда
        team_to_dept = {}
        for tm in all_teams:
            did = tm.get('department_id') or ''
            if not did:
                counts = {}
                member_ids = list(tm.get('member_ids') or [])
                if tm.get('manager_id'):
                    member_ids.append(tm['manager_id'])
                for eid in member_ids:
                    e = next((x for x in all_emps if x['id'] == eid), None)
                    if e and e.get('department_id'):
                        counts[e['department_id']] = counts.get(e['department_id'], 0) + 1
                if counts:
                    did = max(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[0]
            team_to_dept[tm['id']] = did

        # --- Команды (как в v2) ---
        teams_out = []
        for tm in all_teams:
            emp_ids = set()
            if tm.get('manager_id'):
                emp_ids.add(tm['manager_id'])
            for m in (tm.get('member_ids') or []):
                if m:
                    emp_ids.add(m)
            dept_id = team_to_dept.get(tm['id'], '')
            dept = depts_by_id.get(dept_id) or {}
            prev_agg = _aggregate(data, tm.get('name', ''), emp_ids, prev_start, prev_end) if emp_ids else None
            agg = _aggregate(data, tm.get('name', ''), emp_ids, d1, d2, prev=prev_agg, extra={
                'team_id': tm['id'],
                'team_name': tm.get('name', ''),
                'manager_id': tm.get('manager_id', ''),
                'department_id': dept_id,
                'department_name': dept.get('name', ''),
                'department_color': dept.get('color', ''),
            })
            teams_out.append(agg)
        teams_out.sort(key=lambda t: -t['total_hours'])

        # --- Отделы (верхний уровень, НОВОЕ) ---
        depts_out = []
        for dep in all_depts:
            did = dep['id']
            emp_ids = set()
            # все сотрудники отдела
            for e in all_emps:
                if e.get('department_id') == did and not e.get('fired'):
                    emp_ids.add(e['id'])
            # плюс все сотрудники команд этого отдела
            for tm in all_teams:
                if team_to_dept.get(tm['id']) == did:
                    if tm.get('manager_id'):
                        emp_ids.add(tm['manager_id'])
                    for m in (tm.get('member_ids') or []):
                        if m:
                            emp_ids.add(m)

            prev_agg = _aggregate(data, dep.get('name', ''), emp_ids, prev_start, prev_end) if emp_ids else None
            agg = _aggregate(data, dep.get('name', ''), emp_ids, d1, d2, prev=prev_agg, extra={
                'department_id': did,
                'department_name': dep.get('name', ''),
                'department_color': dep.get('color', '#f5d76e'),
                'manager_id': dep.get('head_employee_id') or '',
                'teams': [
                    {'name': t['team_name'], 'total_hours': t['total_hours'], 'total_done': t['total_done'], 'total_overdue': t['total_overdue'], 'coverage': t['coverage']}
                    for t in teams_out if t['department_id'] == did
                ],
                'teams_count': sum(1 for t in teams_out if t['department_id'] == did),
            })
            depts_out.append(agg)
        depts_out.sort(key=lambda d: -d['total_hours'])

        # Итоговые KPI
        all_emp_ids = set(e['id'] for e in all_emps if not e.get('fired'))
        summary_agg = _aggregate(data, 'Все', all_emp_ids, d1, d2) if all_emp_ids else {
            'total_hours': 0, 'total_done': 0, 'total_overdue': 0, 'coverage': 0,
            'active_members': 0, 'members_count': 0
        }
        summary = {
            'depts_count': len(depts_out),
            'teams_count': len(teams_out),
            'employees_total': len(all_emp_ids),
            'active_employees': summary_agg['active_members'],
            'hours_total': summary_agg['total_hours'],
            'tasks_done': summary_agg['total_done'],
            'tasks_overdue': summary_agg['total_overdue'],
            'coverage': summary_agg['coverage'],
        }

        return jsonify({
            'success': True,
            'period': {'from': _iso(d1), 'to': _iso(d2), 'preset': preset},
            'summary': summary,
            'departments': depts_out,
            'teams': teams_out,
        })

    def on_startup(**ctx):
        print('[stats_teams] готов — отделы + команды')

    hooks.on('on_startup', on_startup)

function _setLoaderLabel(label) {

var _loaderStack = [];
function _showLoader(label) {
    _reqCount++;
    _loaderStack.push(label || '');
    if (_minHideTimer) { clearTimeout(_minHideTimer); _minHideTimer = null; }
    var l = $('globalLoader');
    if (l) l.classList.add('active');
    _setLoaderLabel(label);
}
function _hideLoader() {
    _reqCount = Math.max(0, _reqCount - 1);
    _loaderStack.pop();
    if (_reqCount > 0) {
        var top = _loaderStack.length ? _loaderStack[_loaderStack.length - 1] : '';
        _setLoaderLabel(top);
        return;
    }
    if (_minHideTimer) return;
    _minHideTimer = setTimeout(function() {
        if (_reqCount === 0) {
            var l = $('globalLoader');
            if (l) l.classList.remove('active');
            _setLoaderLabel('');
        }
        _minHideTimer = null;
    }, LOADER_MIN_MS);
}

function apiJson(url, options) {
    options = options || {};
    options.headers = Object.assign({}, options.headers || {});
    if (CSRF && options.method && options.method !== 'GET')
        options.headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = CSRF;
    if (!options.credentials) options.credentials = 'same-origin';
    // PATCH v1.0.11: пробрасываем подпись загрузчика (options.label)
    _showLoader(options.label);
    return fetch(url, options).then(function(r) {
        if (r.status === 401) { location.href = '/login'; return new Promise(function(){}); }
        if (r.status === 403) {
            return r.text().then(function(t) {
                var m = 'Недостаточно прав';
                try { var j = JSON.parse(t); if (j.error) m += ': ' + j.error; } catch (e) {}
                throw new Error(m);
            });
        }
        if (!r.ok) {
            return r.text().then(function(t) {
                var msg = 'HTTP ' + r.status;
                try { var j = JSON.parse(t); if (j && j.error) msg += ' — ' + j.error; }
                catch (e) { if (t) msg += ' — ' + t.slice(0, 200); }
                throw new Error(msg);
            });
        }
        return r.json();
    }).finally(_hideLoader);
}

function todayYM() {
    var t = new Date();
    return t.getFullYear() + '-' + String(t.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
}
function todayISO() {
    var t = new Date();
    return t.getFullYear() + '-' + String(t.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(t.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
}
function isoFromDate(d) {
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
}
function parseISO(s) {
    var p = String(s).split('-');
    return new Date(parseInt(p[0], 10), parseInt(p[1], 10) - 1, parseInt(p[2], 10));
}
function addDaysISO(iso, delta) {
    var d = parseISO(iso);
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + delta);
    return isoFromDate(d);
}
function firstOfMonthISO(ym) { return ym + '-01'; }
function firstOfMonthISOFromDate(d) {
    var t = d || new Date();
    return t.getFullYear() + '-' + String(t.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-01';
}
function getMondayISO() {
    var t = new Date();
    var wd = t.getDay();
    var diff = (wd === 0) ? -6 : (1 - wd);
    var mon = new Date(t.getTime() + diff * 86400000);
    return isoFromDate(mon);
}
function getSundayISO() {
    var mon = getMondayISO();
    var sun = new Date(new Date(mon + 'T00:00:00').getTime() + 6 * 86400000);
    return isoFromDate(sun);
}
function setDefaultWeekRange() {
    var a = $('sumDateFrom'), b = $('sumDateTo');
    if (a) a.value = getMondayISO();
    if (b) b.value = getSundayISO();
}
function setMonthRange() {
    var a = $('sumDateFrom'), b = $('sumDateTo');
    if (a) a.value = firstOfMonthISOFromDate(new Date());
    if (b) b.value = todayISO();
}
function formatDateHuman(iso) {
    try {
        var p = iso.split('-');
        return parseInt(p[2], 10) + ' ' + MONTHS_RU[parseInt(p[1], 10) - 1].toLowerCase() + ' ' + p[0];
    } catch (e) { return iso; }
}
function formatDateShort(iso) {

    catch (e) { return iso; }
}
function formatHours(h) {
    h = Number(h) || 0;
    if (h === Math.floor(h)) return h + ' ч';
    return h.toFixed(2).replace(/0+$/, '').replace(/\.$/, '') + ' ч';
}
function shortHours(h) {
    h = Number(h) || 0;
    if (h === Math.floor(h)) return String(h);

}
function hoursClass(h) {
    h = Number(h) || 0;
    if (h <= 0) return '';
    if (h < 2) return 'hours-1';
    if (h < 4) return 'hours-2';
    if (h < 6) return 'hours-3';
    return 'hours-4';
}
function heatmapColor(hours) {
    return cellLightGreen(hours) || '';
}

function cellLightGreen(hours) {
    var h = Number(hours) || 0;
    if (h <= 0) return '';
    if (h > 24) h = 24;
    var yellow = [250, 235, 150];
    var green  = [110, 200, 140];
    var pink   = [250, 180, 200];
    var a, b, t;
    if (h <= 8) {
        a = yellow; b = green; t = h / 8;
    } else {
        a = green; b = pink; t = Math.min((h - 8) / 8, 1);
    }
    var r = Math.round(a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t);
    var g = Math.round(a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t);
    var bl = Math.round(a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t);
    return 'rgb(' + r + ',' + g + ',' + bl + ')';
}

function initials(name) {
    var parts = String(name || '').trim().split(/\s+/);
    if (!parts.length) return '?';
    if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    return (parts[0][0] + (parts[1][0] || '')).toUpperCase();
}

}

        else renderSummary();
    }
    if (state.heatmap) renderHeatmap();
});

document.querySelectorAll('.tracker-tab').forEach(function(tab) {
    tab.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var id = this.getAttribute('data-tab');
        document.querySelectorAll('.tracker-tab').forEach(function(t) {
            t.classList.toggle('active', t === tab);
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('.tracker-panel').forEach(function(p) {
            p.classList.toggle('active', p.id === 'panel-' + id);
        });
        try { localStorage.setItem('tracker_activeTab', id); } catch (e) {}
        if (id === 'tasks') renderTasksFull();
        if (id === 'heatmap') loadHeatmap();
        if (id === 'summary') loadSummary();
        if (id === 'stats') {
            var a = $('stDateFrom'), b = $('stDateTo');
            if (a && !a.value) a.value = firstOfMonthISO(todayYM());
            if (b && !b.value) b.value = todayISO();
            loadStats();
        }
    });
});
(function restoreTab() {
    try {
        var savedTab = localStorage.getItem('tracker_activeTab');
        if (savedTab && savedTab !== 'calendar') {
            var tabBtn = document.querySelector('.tracker-tab[data-tab="' + savedTab + '"]');
            if (tabBtn) setTimeout(function() { tabBtn.click(); }, 50);
        }
        var savedDept = localStorage.getItem('tracker_calDept');
        if (savedDept) state.currentDepartment = savedDept;
    } catch (e) {}
})();

   SEGMENTED
   ============================================================ */
function setupSegmented(elId, initial, onChange) {
    var wrap = $(elId); if (!wrap) return;
    var btns = wrap.querySelectorAll('button');
    btns.forEach(function(b) {
        b.classList.toggle('active', b.getAttribute('data-mode') === initial);
        b.addEventListener('click', function() {
            btns.forEach(function(x) { x.classList.remove('active'); });
            this.classList.add('active');
            onChange(this.getAttribute('data-mode'));
        });
    });
}
