/* ============================================================
   HEATMAP
   ============================================================ */
function loadHeatmap() {
    var qs = '';
    if (state.hmDateFrom && state.hmDateTo) {
        qs = '?from=' + encodeURIComponent(state.hmDateFrom) + '&to=' + encodeURIComponent(state.hmDateTo);
    } else {
        if (!state.hmPeriod) state.hmPeriod = 'month';
        if (!state.hmAnchor) state.hmAnchor = todayISO();
        qs = '?period=' + encodeURIComponent(state.hmPeriod) + '&anchor=' + encodeURIComponent(state.hmAnchor);
    }
    if (typeof renderHmDeptPills === 'function') renderHmDeptPills();
    var dept = (window.__trkHmDepts || []).join(',');
    var team = $('hmTeamFilter') ? ($('hmTeamFilter').value || '') : '';
    if (dept) qs += '&department=' + encodeURIComponent(dept);
    if (team) qs += '&team=' + encodeURIComponent(team);
    var wrap = $('hmWrap');
    if (wrap) wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sum-empty">Загрузка...</div>';
    apiJson('/api/tracker/heatmap' + qs)
        .then(function(d) { state.heatmap = d; renderHeatmap(); })
        .catch(function(err) {
            if (wrap) wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sum-empty" style="color:#e74c3c;">❌ ' + escapeHtml(err.message || 'Ошибка') + '</div>';
        });
}
function renderHeatmap() {
    var d = state.heatmap;
    var wrap = $('hmWrap');
    if (!wrap) return;
    if (!d || !d.rows.length) {
        wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sum-empty">Нет сотрудников или данных за период.</div>';
        return;
    }
    var title = $('hmMonthTitle');
    if (title) title.textContent = d.from ? (formatDateHuman(d.from) + ' — ' + formatDateHuman(d.to)) : '';
    var today = todayISO();
    var head = '<tr><th class="emp-col">Сотрудник</th>';
    d.days.forEach(function(dk) {
        var wd = new Date(dk + 'T00:00:00').getDay();
        var cls = [];
        if (wd === 0 || wd === 6) cls.push('weekend-col');
        if (dk === today) cls.push('today-col');
        head += '<th' + (cls.length ? ' class="' + cls.join(' ') + '"' : '') + ' title="' + escapeHtml(dk) + '">' + escapeHtml(formatDateShort(dk)) + '</th>';
    });
    head += '<th class="total-col">Итого</th></tr>';
    var body = '';
    d.rows.forEach(function(r) {
        body += '<tr>';
        var fired = r.employee_fired ? ' 🚪' : '';
        body += '<td class="emp-cell" data-emp="' + escapeHtml(r.employee_id) + '">'
            + '<span class="emp-dot" style="background:' + escapeHtml(r.employee_color) + ';box-shadow:0 0 6px ' + escapeHtml(r.employee_color) + ';"></span>'
            + escName(r.employee_name) + fired + '</td>';
        r.cells.forEach(function(c) {
            var cls = [], content = '', titleArr = [c.date];
            var abs = c.absence_type || (c.is_vacation ? 'vacation' : '');
            if (abs) { cls.push(absenceClass(abs) + '-cell'); titleArr.push(absenceLabel(abs)); content = absenceIcon(abs); }
            else if (c.is_holiday) { cls.push('holiday-cell'); titleArr.push('🎉 Праздник'); content = '🎉'; }
            else if (c.missing) { cls.push('missing-cell'); titleArr.push('⚠ Не заполнено'); content = '!'; }
            else if (c.is_weekend) { cls.push('weekend-cell'); titleArr.push('Выходной'); }
            else if (c.hours > 0) {
                var col = cellLightGreen(c.hours);
                titleArr.push(formatHours(c.hours));
                if (c.is_today) cls.push('today-cell');
                if (c.is_remote) cls.push('has-remote');
                var cl = cls.length ? ' class="' + cls.join(' ') + '"' : '';
                body += '<td' + cl + ' style="background:' + col + ';color:#1a9c52;font-weight:700;" '
                    + 'data-emp="' + escapeHtml(r.employee_id) + '" data-date="' + escapeHtml(c.date) + '" '
                    + 'title="' + escapeHtml(titleArr.join(' · ')) + '">' + c.hours + '</td>';
                return;
            } else { titleArr.push('—'); }
            if (c.is_today) cls.push('today-cell');
            var cl2 = cls.length ? ' class="' + cls.join(' ') + '"' : '';
            body += '<td' + cl2 + ' data-emp="' + escapeHtml(r.employee_id) + '" data-date="' + escapeHtml(c.date) + '" '
                + 'title="' + escapeHtml(titleArr.join(' · ')) + '">' + content + '</td>';
        });
        body += '<td class="total-cell">' + formatHours(r.total_hours) + '</td></tr>';
    });
    wrap.innerHTML = '<table class="hm-table"><thead>' + head + '</thead><tbody>' + body + '</tbody></table>';
    wrap.querySelectorAll('td[data-emp][data-date]').forEach(function(td) {
        if (td.classList.contains('total-cell')) return;
        if (td.classList.contains('emp-cell')) {
            td.addEventListener('click', function() {
                var empId = this.getAttribute('data-emp');
                var emp = state.employees.find(function(x) { return x.id === empId; });
                if (!emp) return;
                if (confirm('Показать календарь сотрудника «' + maskName(emp.name) + '»?')) {
                    var tabBtn = document.querySelector('.tracker-tab[data-tab="calendar"]');
                    if (tabBtn) tabBtn.click();
                    var cf = $('calEmployeeFilter');
                    if (cf) cf.value = empId;
                    state.currentEmployee = empId;
                    loadCalendar();
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        td.addEventListener('click', function() {
            openEmpDayModal(this.getAttribute('data-emp'), this.getAttribute('data-date'));
        });
    });
    var legend = $('hmLegendBar');
    if (legend) {
        var stops = [
            { label: '0',       color: 'rgba(128,128,128,0.15)' },
            { label: '2',       color: heatmapColor(2) },
            { label: '4',       color: heatmapColor(4) },
            { label: '6',       color: heatmapColor(6) },
            { label: '8',       color: heatmapColor(8) },
            { label: '10',      color: heatmapColor(10) },
            { label: '12+',     color: heatmapColor(12) }
        ];
        legend.innerHTML =
            '<div class="hm-legend-bar-row">' +
                stops.map(function(s) {
                    return '<span class="hm-legend-cell" style="background:' + s.color + ';" title="' + s.label + ' ч"></span>';
                }).join('') +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="hm-legend-bar-labels">' +
                stops.map(function(s) {
                    return '<span class="hm-legend-bar-label">' + s.label + '</span>';
                }).join('') +
            '</div>';
    }
}
function _shiftHmPeriod(delta) {
    var anchor = state.hmAnchor || todayISO();
    var d = parseISO(anchor);
    var p = state.hmPeriod || 'month';
    if (p === 'year') d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() + delta);
    else if (p === 'quarter') d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + delta * 3);
    else if (p === 'week') d.setDate(d.getDate() + delta * 7);
    else d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + delta);
    state.hmAnchor = isoFromDate(d);
    state.hmDateFrom = ''; state.hmDateTo = '';
    loadHeatmap();
}
on('hmPrevBtn', 'click', function() { _shiftHmPeriod(-1); });
on('hmNextBtn', 'click', function() { _shiftHmPeriod(1); });
on('hmTodayBtn', 'click', function() {
    state.hmDateFrom = ''; state.hmDateTo = '';
    if ($('hmDateFrom')) $('hmDateFrom').value = '';
    if ($('hmDateTo')) $('hmDateTo').value = '';
    state.hmAnchor = todayISO();
    loadHeatmap();
});
on('hmPeriodSeg', 'click', function(e) {
    var b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return;
    this.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(x) { x.classList.remove('active'); });
    b.classList.add('active');
    state.hmPeriod = b.getAttribute('data-p') || 'month';
    state.hmDateFrom = ''; state.hmDateTo = '';
    if ($('hmDateFrom')) $('hmDateFrom').value = '';
    if ($('hmDateTo')) $('hmDateTo').value = '';
    loadHeatmap();
});
on('hmApplyBtn', 'click', function() {
    var f = $('hmDateFrom') ? $('hmDateFrom').value : '';
    var t = $('hmDateTo') ? $('hmDateTo').value : '';
    if (!f || !t) { notify('❌ Укажите обе даты', 'error'); return; }
    state.hmDateFrom = f; state.hmDateTo = t;
    loadHeatmap();
});
on('hmMonthBtn', 'click', function() {
    state.hmDateFrom = ''; state.hmDateTo = '';
    var t = new Date();
    var y = t.getFullYear(), m = t.getMonth() + 1;
    var last = new Date(y, m, 0).getDate();
    state.hmDateFrom = y + '-' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') + '-01';
    state.hmDateTo = y + '-' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(last).padStart(2, '0');
    if ($('hmDateFrom')) $('hmDateFrom').value = state.hmDateFrom;
    if ($('hmDateTo')) $('hmDateTo').value = state.hmDateTo;
    loadHeatmap();
});
on('hmDeptFilter', 'change', loadHeatmap);
on('hmTeamFilter', 'change', loadHeatmap);

/* ============================================================
   КАРТОЧКА СОТРУДНИКА ЗА ДЕНЬ
   ============================================================ */
function openEmpDayModal(empId, dateStr) {
    apiJson('/api/tracker/employee/day?employee=' + encodeURIComponent(empId) + '&date=' + encodeURIComponent(dateStr))
        .then(function(d) {
            if (!d.success) throw new Error(d.error || 'Ошибка');
            renderEmpDayModal(d);
            var m = $('empDayModal'); if (m) m.classList.add('active');
        })
        .catch(function(err) { if (err && (err.message || '').indexOf('cancelled') !== -1) return; notify('❌ ' + (err.message || 'Ошибка'), 'error'); });
}
function renderEmpDayModal(d) {
    var emp = d.employee || {}, entries = d.entries || [];
    var badge = '';
    var abs = d.absence_type || (d.in_vacation ? 'vacation' : '');
    if (abs) {
        var cls = 'vac';
        if (abs === 'sick_leave') cls = 'sick';
        else if (abs === 'business_trip') cls = 'trip';
        else if (abs === 'remote') cls = 'remote';
        badge = '<span class="emp-day-badge ' + cls + '">' + escapeHtml(absenceLabel(abs)) + '</span>';
    } else if (d.is_workday && entries.length === 0) {
        badge = '<span class="emp-day-badge warn">⚠ Не заполнено</span>';
    } else if (entries.length > 0) {
        badge = '<span class="emp-day-badge ok">✓ Заполнено</span>';
    }
    var dept = emp.department ? ' · 🏢 ' + escapeHtml(emp.department) : '';
    var head = $('empDayHead');
    if (head) head.innerHTML = '<div class="emp-day-avatar" style="background:' + escapeHtml(emp.color || '#00897b') + ';box-shadow:0 0 12px ' + escapeHtml(emp.color || '#00897b') + ';">'
        + escapeHtml(initials(emp.name)) + '</div>'
        + '<div class="emp-day-info"><div class="emp-day-name">' + escName(emp.name || '—') + '</div>'
        + '<div class="emp-day-role">' + escapeHtml(emp.role || '') + dept + ' · ' + escapeHtml(formatDateHuman(d.date)) + '</div></div>'
        + '<div class="emp-day-stats">'
        + '<div class="emp-day-stat"><span class="val">' + formatHours(d.total_hours) + '</span><span class="lbl">часов</span></div>'
        + '<div class="emp-day-stat"><span class="val">' + entries.length + '</span><span class="lbl">задач</span></div>'
        + '</div>' + badge;
    var list = $('empDayList'); if (!list) return;
    if (!entries.length) { list.innerHTML = '<div class="day-empty">За этот день отметок нет.</div>'; return; }
    var html = '';
    var full = [];
    entries.forEach(function(en) {
        var f = Object.assign({}, en);
        f.employee_id = emp.id || '';
        f.employee_name = emp.name; f.employee_color = emp.color;
        f.employee_department = emp.department; f.date = d.date;
        full.push(f);
        html += dayEntryCard(f, false);
    });
    list.innerHTML = html;
    bindDayEntryActions(list, full);
}

on('tskGridCols', 'change', function() {
    var v = parseInt(this.value, 10) || 3;
    if (v < 1) v = 1;
    if (v > 5) v = 5;
    state.tskGridCols = v;
    try { localStorage.setItem('tracker_tsk_cols', String(v)); } catch (e) {}
    renderTasksFull();
});
(function initTskDisplay() {
    var cols = 3;
    var legacyMode = 'grid';
    try {
        legacyMode = localStorage.getItem('tracker_tsk_display') || 'grid';
        cols = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('tracker_tsk_cols') || '3', 10) || 3;
    } catch (e) {}
    if (legacyMode === 'list') cols = 1;
    if (cols < 1 || cols > 5) cols = 3;
    state.tskDisplayMode = 'grid';
    state.tskGridCols = cols;
    var wrap = $('tskColsWrap');
    if (wrap) wrap.style.display = '';
    var sel = $('tskGridCols');
    if (sel) sel.value = String(cols);
})();

document.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var id = this.getAttribute('data-close');
        var m = $(id);
        if (m) m.classList.remove('active');
        if (id === 'dayModal') {
            var a = $('dayModalLeftActions'); if (a) a.style.display = '';
            var c = $('dayClearBtn'); if (c) c.style.display = '';
        }
    });
});
document.querySelectorAll('.modal').forEach(function(m) {
    m.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target === m) {
            m.classList.remove('active');
            if (m.id === 'dayModal') {
                var a = $('dayModalLeftActions'); if (a) a.style.display = '';
                var c = $('dayClearBtn'); if (c) c.style.display = '';
            }
        }
    });
});

    if (e.key === 'Escape') {

   PATCH 2026-10-06 — мультитеги, автосортировка по тегам

(function() {
    function _initTagFilterUI() {
        ['tskTagFilter', 'sumTagFilter', 'stTagFilter'].forEach(function(id) {
            var sel = document.getElementById(id);
            if (!sel) return;
            if (document.getElementById(id + 'Pills')) return;
            var wrap = document.createElement('div');
            wrap.className = 'tag-filter-pills';
            wrap.id = id + 'Pills';
            wrap.setAttribute('data-target', id);
            sel.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, sel);
            sel.style.display = 'none';
        });
    }
    function _renderTagPills() {
        ['tskTagFilter', 'sumTagFilter', 'stTagFilter'].forEach(function(id) {
            var wrap = document.getElementById(id + 'Pills');
            if (!wrap) return;
            var cur = (window.__trkSelectedTags && window.__trkSelectedTags[id]) || [];
            var all = Object.keys(window.__trkAllTags || {}).sort();
            if (!all.length) { wrap.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--trk-meta);font-size:0.72rem;">—</span>'; return; }
            var html = '';
            all.forEach(function(t) {
                var act = cur.indexOf(t) !== -1 ? ' active' : '';
                html += '<button type="button" class="tag-chip' + act + '" data-tag="' + t + '">#' + t + '</button>';
            });
            if (cur.length) {
                html += '<button type="button" class="tag-clear" title="Очистить">✕</button>';
            }
            if (cur.length > 1) {
                var mode = (window.__trkTagMode && window.__trkTagMode[id]) || 'any';
                html += '<button type="button" class="tag-mode" data-target="' + id + '" title="Логика фильтра: И (все теги) / ИЛИ (любой тег)">'
                    + (mode === 'all' ? 'И' : 'ИЛИ') + '</button>';
            }
            wrap.innerHTML = html;
            wrap.querySelectorAll('.tag-chip').forEach(function(btn) {
                btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    var t = this.getAttribute('data-tag');
                    var arr = window.__trkSelectedTags[id] = window.__trkSelectedTags[id] || [];
                    var i = arr.indexOf(t);
                    if (i === -1) arr.push(t); else arr.splice(i, 1);
                    _renderTagPills();
                    var ev = { tsk: 'renderTasksFull', sum: 'loadSummary', st: 'loadStats' };
                    var pre = id.slice(0, 3);
                    if (ev[pre] && typeof window[ev[pre]] === 'function') window[ev[pre]]();
                    else if (typeof window.__trkLoadSummary === 'function') window.__trkLoadSummary();
                });
            });
            var clr = wrap.querySelector('.tag-clear');
            if (clr) clr.addEventListener('click', function() {
                window.__trkSelectedTags[id] = [];
                _renderTagPills();
                if (id.indexOf('tsk') === 0) renderTasksFull();
                else if (id.indexOf('sum') === 0 && window.__trkLoadSummary) window.__trkLoadSummary();
                else if (typeof loadStats === 'function') loadStats();
            });
            var modeBtn = wrap.querySelector('.tag-mode');
            if (modeBtn) modeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                window.__trkTagMode = window.__trkTagMode || {};
                window.__trkTagMode[id] = (window.__trkTagMode[id] === 'all') ? 'any' : 'all';
                _renderTagPills();
                if (id.indexOf('tsk') === 0) renderTasksFull();
                else if (id.indexOf('sum') === 0 && window.__trkLoadSummary) window.__trkLoadSummary();
                else if (typeof loadStats === 'function') loadStats();
            });
        });
    }
    window.__trkRenderTagPills = _renderTagPills;
    window.__trkInitTagFilterUI = _initTagFilterUI;
    window.__trkSelectedTags = { tskTagFilter: [], sumTagFilter: [], stTagFilter: [] };
    window.__trkTagMode = { tskTagFilter: 'any', sumTagFilter: 'any', stTagFilter: 'any' };
    window.__trkAllTags = {};
})();

   PATCH 2026-10-06 — Свод: тулбар в 2 ряда

(function() {
    'use strict';

    function reorganize() {
        var toolbar = document.querySelector('#panel-summary .sum-toolbar');
        if (!toolbar || toolbar.classList.contains('sum-toolbar-v2')) return;

        var $id = function(id) { return document.getElementById(id); };

        var arrowsL = toolbar.querySelectorAll('.period-arrows')[0];
        var arrowsR = toolbar.querySelectorAll('.period-arrows')[1];
        var sumGroup = toolbar.querySelector('.sum-group');
        var weekBtn = $id('sumWeekBtn');
        var monthBtn = $id('sumMonthBtn');
        var applyBtn = $id('sumApplyBtn');
        var showTotalsLabel = toolbar.querySelector('label.sum-toggle');
        var viewModeSeg = $id('sumViewMode');
        var taskRowModeSeg = $id('sumTaskRowMode');

        var filterLabels = [];
        ['sumDeptFilter', 'sumTeamFilter', 'sumEmployeeFilter', 'sumTaskFilter', 'sumTagFilter'].forEach(function(fid) {
            var el = $id(fid);
            if (!el) return;
            var lbl = el.closest('.sum-filter');
            if (lbl) filterLabels.push(lbl);
        });

        var row1 = document.createElement('div');
        row1.className = 'sum-row sum-row-1';
        var row2 = document.createElement('div');
        row2.className = 'sum-row sum-row-2';

        if (arrowsL) row1.appendChild(arrowsL);
        if (sumGroup) row1.appendChild(sumGroup);
        if (arrowsR) row1.appendChild(arrowsR);

        if (weekBtn || monthBtn || applyBtn) {
            var sep1 = document.createElement('span');
            sep1.className = 'sum-sep';
            row1.appendChild(sep1);
        }
        if (weekBtn) row1.appendChild(weekBtn);
        if (monthBtn) row1.appendChild(monthBtn);
        if (applyBtn) row1.appendChild(applyBtn);

        if (showTotalsLabel || viewModeSeg || taskRowModeSeg) {
            var sep2 = document.createElement('span');
            sep2.className = 'sum-sep';
            row1.appendChild(sep2);
        }
        if (showTotalsLabel) row1.appendChild(showTotalsLabel);
        if (viewModeSeg) row1.appendChild(viewModeSeg);
        if (taskRowModeSeg) row1.appendChild(taskRowModeSeg);

        var spacer = document.createElement('div');
        spacer.className = 'sum-spacer';
        row1.appendChild(spacer);

        filterLabels.forEach(function(lbl) { row2.appendChild(lbl); });

        toolbar.innerHTML = '';
        toolbar.appendChild(row1);
        toolbar.appendChild(row2);
        toolbar.classList.add('sum-toolbar-v2');

        var observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
            var eb = $id('excelExportBtn');
            if (eb && eb.parentNode !== row1) {
                row1.insertBefore(eb, spacer);
            }
        });
        observer.observe(toolbar, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    function boot() {
        setTimeout(reorganize, 200);
        setTimeout(reorganize, 900);
        setTimeout(reorganize, 2000);
    }
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    } else {
        boot();
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.tracker-tab[data-tab="summary"]')) {
            setTimeout(reorganize, 150);
        }
    });
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 2026-10-06 — Задачи: живой поиск
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    var KEY = 'tracker_tsk_search';
    var input, clearBtn, countEl, list;
    var _t = null;

    function getQuery() {
        return input ? (input.value || '').trim().toLowerCase() : '';
    }

    function haystack(t) {
        if (!t) return '';
        var parts = [
            t.name || '',
            t.description || '',
            t.folder || '',
            t.order_ref || '',
            (t.tags || []).join(' '),
            t.id || ''
        ];
        return parts.join(' \u0001 ').toLowerCase();
    }

    function matches(hay, query) {
        if (!query) return true;
        var terms = query.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        for (var i = 0; i < terms.length; i++) {
            if (hay.indexOf(terms[i]) === -1) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    function getTasksMap() {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        var map = {};
        if (st && st.tasks) {
            for (var i = 0; i < st.tasks.length; i++) map[st.tasks[i].id] = st.tasks[i];
        }
        return map;
    }

    function apply() {
        if (!list) list = document.getElementById('tasksFullList');
        if (!list) return;
        var query = getQuery();
        if (clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = query ? '' : 'none';

        var cards = list.querySelectorAll('.task-card, .dict-item');
        if (!cards.length) {
            if (countEl) countEl.textContent = '';
            return;
        }

        if (!query) {
            for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) cards[i].style.display = '';
            if (countEl) countEl.textContent = '';
            return;
        }

        var map = getTasksMap();
        var shown = 0, total = cards.length;
        for (var j = 0; j < cards.length; j++) {
            var c = cards[j];
            var id = c.getAttribute('data-id');
            var t = map[id];
            if (matches(haystack(t), query)) {
                c.style.display = '';
                shown++;
            } else {
                c.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }
        if (countEl) {
            countEl.textContent = shown + ' из ' + total;
            countEl.classList.toggle('no-match', shown === 0);
        }
    }

    function onChange() {
        var v = input ? (input.value || '') : '';
        try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, v); } catch (e) {}
        if (_t) clearTimeout(_t);
        _t = setTimeout(apply, 120);
    }

    function hookList() {
        var l = document.getElementById('tasksFullList');
        if (!l || l === list) return;
        list = l;
        var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { apply(); });
        obs.observe(list, { childList: true });
        apply();
    }

    function boot() {
        input = document.getElementById('tskSearchInput');
        clearBtn = document.getElementById('tskSearchClear');
        countEl = document.getElementById('tskSearchCount');
        if (!input) return;

        try {
            var saved = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
            if (saved) input.value = saved;
        } catch (e) {}

        input.addEventListener('input', onChange);

        input.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                e.preventDefault();
                this.value = '';
                onChange();
                this.blur();
            }
        });

        if (clearBtn) clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            input.value = '';
            onChange();
            input.focus();
        });

        hookList();

        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.tracker-tab[data-tab="tasks"]')) {
                setTimeout(function() { hookList(); apply(); }, 200);
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key !== '/' || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
            var t = e.target;
            if (t && (t.tagName === 'INPUT' || t.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || t.isContentEditable)) return;
            var panel = document.getElementById('panel-tasks');
            if (!panel || !panel.classList.contains('active')) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            input.focus();
            input.select();
        });
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { setTimeout(boot, 300); });
    } else {
        setTimeout(boot, 300);
    }
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 2026-10-06 — Свод: свернуть всё / развернуть всё (v2)
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    var STORAGE = 'sum_collapsed';

    function _st() { return window.__trkState || null; }
    function _render() {
        if (window.__trkRenderSummaryGrid) window.__trkRenderSummaryGrid();
    }

    function loadCollapsed() {
        try {
            var raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE);
            var obj = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
            if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object' || Array.isArray(obj)) return {};
            return obj;
        } catch (e) { return {}; }
    }

    function saveCollapsed() {
        var st = _st();
        if (!st) return;
        try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE, JSON.stringify(st.sumCollapsed || {})); } catch (e) {}
    }

    function initCollapsed() {
        var st = _st();
        if (!st) return;
        var saved = loadCollapsed();
        var cur = st.sumCollapsed || {};
        st.sumCollapsed = Object.assign({}, cur, saved);
    }

    function isAllCollapsed() {
        var st = _st();
        if (st && st.summary && (st.summary.rows || []).length) {
            var rows = st.summary.rows;
            var c = st.sumCollapsed || {};
            for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
                if (!c[rows[i].employee_id]) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
        var btns = document.querySelectorAll('#sumWrap .emp-collapse-btn');
        if (!btns.length) return false;
        var domAll = true;
        btns.forEach(function(b) { if (b.textContent.trim() !== '▶') domAll = false; });
        return domAll;
    }

    function toggleAll(force) {
        var st = _st();
        if (!st || !st.summary) return;
        var rows = st.summary.rows || [];
        if (!rows.length) return;
        var target = (typeof force === 'boolean') ? force : !isAllCollapsed();
        if (target) {
            if (!st.sumCollapsed) st.sumCollapsed = {};
            rows.forEach(function(r) {
                if (r && r.employee_id) st.sumCollapsed[r.employee_id] = true;
            });
        } else {
            st.sumCollapsed = {};
        }
        saveCollapsed();
        _render();
    }

    function updateBtn() {
        var btn = document.getElementById('sumCollapseAllBtn');
        if (!btn) return;
        var st = _st();
        var isGrid = st ? !!st.summaryIsGrid : true;
        btn.style.display = isGrid ? '' : 'none';
        var all = isAllCollapsed();
        btn.textContent = all ? '▶ Развернуть все' : '▼ Свернуть все';
        btn.title = all ? 'Развернуть все блоки сотрудников' : 'Свернуть все блоки сотрудников';
    }

    function ensureBtn() {
        var toolbar = document.querySelector('#panel-summary .sum-toolbar');
        if (!toolbar) return;
        var container = toolbar.querySelector('.sum-row-1') || toolbar;
        var btn = document.getElementById('sumCollapseAllBtn');
        if (btn && btn.getAttribute('data-v2') !== '1') {
            btn.parentNode.removeChild(btn);
            btn = null;
        }
        if (!btn) {
            btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.id = 'sumCollapseAllBtn';
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.setAttribute('data-v2', '1');
            btn.className = 'btn btn-secondary sum-collapse-all-btn';
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() { toggleAll(); });
            var spacer = container.querySelector('.sum-spacer');
            if (spacer) container.insertBefore(btn, spacer);
            else container.appendChild(btn);
        }
        updateBtn();
    }

    window.__trkOnSummaryRender = function() { ensureBtn(); };

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
        if (e.target.closest('.emp-collapse-btn')) {
            setTimeout(saveCollapsed, 30);
            setTimeout(updateBtn, 60);
        }
        if (e.target.closest('#sumViewMode button')) {
            setTimeout(updateBtn, 150);
        }
    }, true);

    function boot() {
        initCollapsed();
        setTimeout(ensureBtn, 700);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    } else {
        boot();
    }

    window.__trkCollapseAll = { toggle: toggleAll, save: saveCollapsed, load: loadCollapsed, isAll: isAllCollapsed };
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 2026-10-06 — Свод: ресайз колонки «Задача» (v2)
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    function attachTaskColResize(th) {
        if (!th || th._rszHooked) return;
        th._rszHooked = true;

        th.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
            var rect = th.getBoundingClientRect();
            var dx = rect.right - e.clientX;
            th.style.cursor = (dx >= 0 && dx <= 8) ? 'col-resize' : '';
        });

        th.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
            th.style.cursor = '';
        });

        th.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
            var rect = th.getBoundingClientRect();
            var dx = rect.right - e.clientX;
            if (dx < 0 || dx > 8) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();

            var startX = e.clientX;
            var cs = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
            var startW = parseInt(cs.getPropertyValue('--sum-task-w'), 10);
            if (!isFinite(startW) || startW < 40) startW = th.offsetWidth;

            document.body.style.cursor = 'col-resize';
            document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

            function onMove(ev) {
                var w = Math.max(120, Math.min(1200, startW + ev.clientX - startX));
                document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--sum-task-w', w + 'px');
            }
            function onUp() {
                document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
                document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
                document.body.style.cursor = '';
                document.body.style.userSelect = '';
                var cur = parseInt(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--sum-task-w'), 10);
                if (isFinite(cur)) { try { localStorage.setItem('sum_task_w', String(cur)); } catch (er) {} }
            }
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
            document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
        });
    }

    function hook() {
        var th = document.querySelector('#sumWrap thead th.task-col');
        if (th) attachTaskColResize(th);
    }

    function installObserver() {
        var wrap = document.getElementById('sumWrap');
        if (!wrap || wrap._rszObserver) return;
        wrap._rszObserver = new MutationObserver(function() { hook(); });
        wrap._rszObserver.observe(wrap, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }

    function boot() {
        installObserver();
        setTimeout(hook, 500);
        setTimeout(hook, 1500);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    } else {
        boot();
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
        if (e.target.closest('.tracker-tab[data-tab="summary"]')) {
            setTimeout(function() { installObserver(); hook(); }, 250);
        }
        if (e.target.closest('#sumViewMode button')) {
            setTimeout(hook, 350);
        }
    });

    window.__trkResizeTaskCol = hook;
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 2026-10-06 — Публичные helper'ы маскирования для плагинов
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';
    function maskFn(name) {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st || !st.maskNames) return String(name == null ? '' : name);
        var s = String(name == null ? '' : name);
        if (!s) return s;
        return s.split(/\s+/).map(function(w) {
            if (w.length <= 1) return w;
            return w[0] + new Array(w.length).join('*');
        }).join(' ');
    }
    window.__trkMaskName = maskFn;
    window.__trkMaskNames = false;
    window.__trkEscName = function(name) {
        var s = maskFn(name);
        return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c) {
            return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];
        });
    };
})();

/* ============================================================
   PATCH 2026-10-06 — Дневная карточка: вид «По сотрудникам» (плитки)
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    function _esc(s) {
        return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c) {
            return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];
        });
    }
    function _initials(name) {
        var parts = String(name || '').trim().split(/\s+/);
        if (!parts.length) return '?';
        if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
        return (parts[0][0] + (parts[1][0] || '')).toUpperCase();
    }
    function _fmtH(h) {
        h = Number(h) || 0;
        if (h === Math.floor(h)) return h + ' ч';
        return h.toFixed(2).replace(/0+$/, '').replace(/\.$/, '') + ' ч';
    }
    function _mask(name) {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st || !st.maskNames) return name;
        return String(name == null ? '' : name).split(/\s+/).map(function(w) {
            if (w.length <= 1) return w;
            return w[0] + new Array(w.length).join('*');
        }).join(' ');
    }

    window.__trkRenderDayByEmployee = function(entries, totalHours, day) {
        var listEl = document.getElementById('dayList');
        if (!listEl) return false;
        if (!entries || !entries.length) return false;

        var byEmp = {};
        entries.forEach(function(en) {
            var eid = en.employee_id || '?';
            if (!byEmp[eid]) {
                byEmp[eid] = {
                    id: eid,
                    name: en.employee_name || '',
                    color: en.employee_color || '#888',
                    dept: en.employee_department || '',
                    tasks: [],
                    total: 0
                };
            }
            byEmp[eid].tasks.push(en);
            byEmp[eid].total += parseFloat(en.hours) || 0;
        });

        var emps = Object.keys(byEmp).map(function(k) { return byEmp[k]; });
        emps.sort(function(a, b) { return b.total - a.total; });

        var html = '<div class="day-emp-tiles">';
        emps.forEach(function(e) {
            var bg = _esc(e.color);
            html += '<div class="day-emp-tile" style="--det-accent:' + bg + ';">'
                + '<div class="det-head">'
                +   '<div class="det-avatar" style="background:' + bg + ';">' + _esc(_initials(e.name)) + '</div>'
                +   '<div class="det-meta">'
                +     '<div class="det-name">' + _esc(_mask(e.name)) + '</div>'
                +     (e.dept ? '<div class="det-dept">🏢 ' + _esc(e.dept) + '</div>' : '')
                +   '</div>'
                +   '<div class="det-total">' + _fmtH(e.total) + '</div>'
                + '</div>'
                + '<div class="det-tasks">';
            e.tasks.sort(function(a, b) { return (parseFloat(b.hours) || 0) - (parseFloat(a.hours) || 0); });
            e.tasks.forEach(function(t) {
                html += '<div class="det-task" data-id="' + t.id + '">'
                    + '<span class="det-task-ico">' + _esc(t.task_icon || '📋') + '</span>'
                    + '<span class="det-task-name' + (t.overdue ? ' overdue' : '') + '" title="' + _esc(t.comment || '') + '">' + _esc(t.task_name || '') + '</span>'
                    + '<span class="det-task-hours">' + _fmtH(t.hours) + '</span>'
                    + '</div>';
            });
            html += '</div></div>';
        });
        html += '</div>';
        listEl.innerHTML = html;
        return true;
    };

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
        var btn = e.target.closest('#dayViewMode button');
        if (!btn) return;
        var mode = btn.getAttribute('data-mode');
        if (mode !== 'task' && mode !== 'employee') return;
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st) return;
        st.dayViewMode = mode;
        try { localStorage.setItem('tracker_day_view', mode); } catch (er) {}
        var wrap = document.getElementById('dayViewMode');
        if (wrap) wrap.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b) {
            b.classList.toggle('active', b.getAttribute('data-mode') === mode);
        });
        if (window.__trkOpenDayModal && st.currentDay) {
            window.__trkOpenDayModal(st.currentDay);
        }
    });

    setTimeout(function() {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        var wrap = document.getElementById('dayViewMode');
        if (!wrap || !st) return;
        var m = st.dayViewMode || 'task';
        wrap.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b) {
            b.classList.toggle('active', b.getAttribute('data-mode') === m);
        });
    }, 400);
})();

   PATCH 2026-10-06 — Создать задачу из карточки дня
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    function looksLikeCreateTask(btn) {
        if (!btn) return false;
        var id = (btn.id || '').toLowerCase();
        if (id === 'daycreatetaskbtn' || id === 'dayaddtaskbtn' || id === 'daynewtaskbtn' || id === 'createtaskfromday') return true;
        if (btn.getAttribute && btn.getAttribute('data-act') === 'new-task-from-day') return true;
        var t = (btn.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!t) return false;
        if (/новая\s*задач|создать\s*задач|\+\s*задач|добавить\s*задач/.test(t)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (window.__trkLogTaskFromLogV3) return;
    if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
    var dayModal = document.getElementById('dayModal');
    if (!dayModal || !dayModal.classList.contains('active')) return;
        var btn = e.target.closest('button');
        if (!btn) return;
        if (btn.id === 'addTaskBtn' || btn.id === 'addTaskBtn2') return;
        if (!looksLikeCreateTask(btn)) return;

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

        var st = window.__trkState;
        var dk = st && st.currentDay;

        dayModal.classList.remove('active');

        if (typeof window.__trkOpenTaskModal === 'function') {
            window.__trkOpenTaskModal(null);
        } else {
            var alt = document.getElementById('addTaskBtn2') || document.getElementById('addTaskBtn');
            if (alt) alt.click();
        }
        if (dk) window.__trkPendingDayReopen = dk;
    }, true);

    function attachObserver() {
        var taskModal = document.getElementById('taskModal');
        if (!taskModal || taskModal._reopenHooked) return;
        taskModal._reopenHooked = true;
        var obs = new MutationObserver(function() {
            var isOpen = taskModal.classList.contains('active');
            if (isOpen) return;
            if (!window.__trkPendingDayReopen) return;
            var dk = window.__trkPendingDayReopen;
            window.__trkPendingDayReopen = null;
            setTimeout(function() {
                if (typeof window.__trkOpenDayModal === 'function') {
                    window.__trkOpenDayModal(dk);
                }
            }, 800);
        });
        obs.observe(taskModal, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    }

    function boot() { setTimeout(attachObserver, 400); }
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    } else {
        boot();
    }
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 2026-10-06 — Кнопка «Новая задача» в карточке отметки
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    function hasPerm(k) {
        return !!(window.REESTR_PERMS && window.REESTR_PERMS[k]);
    }

    function looksLikeCreateTask(btn) {
        if (!btn || !btn.closest) return false;
        if (btn.id === 'logCreateTaskBtn') return true;
        if (btn.classList.contains('log-create-task-btn')) return true;
        var t = (btn.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!t) return false;
        return /новая\s*задач|создать\s*задач|\+\s*задач|добавить\s*задач/.test(t);
    }

    function ensureButton() {
        var logModal = document.getElementById('logModal');
        if (!logModal) return;
        var btn = logModal.querySelector('.log-create-task-btn, #logCreateTaskBtn');
        if (!btn) {
            var select = document.getElementById('log_task');
            if (!select) return;
            btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.id = 'logCreateTaskBtn';
            btn.className = 'log-create-task-btn';
            btn.textContent = '➕ Новая задача';
            btn.title = 'Создать задачу и вернуться к заполнению отметки';
            if (select.parentNode) {
                select.parentNode.insertBefore(btn, select.nextSibling);
            }
        }
        btn.style.display = hasPerm('action.task.create') ? '' : 'none';
    }

    function captureLogState() {
        var g = function(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : ''; };
        return {
            id: g('log_id'),
            date: g('log_date'),
            hours: g('log_hours'),
            employee_id: g('log_employee'),
            status: g('log_status'),
            comment: g('log_comment'),
            link: g('log_link'),
            task_id: g('log_task')
        };
    }

    function reopenLogFrom(s, newTaskId) {
        if (!s) return;
        var fake = {
            id: s.id || null,
            employee_id: s.employee_id || '',
            task_id: newTaskId || s.task_id || '',
            date: s.date || '',
            hours: parseFloat(s.hours) || 8,
            status: s.status || 'in_progress',
            comment: s.comment || '',
            link: s.link || ''
        };
        if (typeof window.__trkOpenLogModal === 'function') {
            window.__trkOpenLogModal(fake);
            setTimeout(function() {
                var t = document.getElementById('log_task');
                if (t && newTaskId) t.value = newTaskId;
                var h = document.getElementById('log_hours');
                if (h) h.focus();
            }, 80);
        }
    }

    function setupTaskModalObserver() {
        var taskModal = document.getElementById('taskModal');
        if (!taskModal || taskModal._logReopenHooked) return;
        taskModal._logReopenHooked = true;
        var obs = new MutationObserver(function() {
            if (taskModal.classList.contains('active')) return;
            if (!window.__trkPendingLogState) return;
            var s = window.__trkPendingLogState;
            var beforeIds = window.__trkPendingLogTaskIdsBefore || [];
            window.__trkPendingLogState = null;
            window.__trkPendingLogTaskIdsBefore = null;

            var waited = 0;
            var step = 200;
            var timer = setInterval(function() {
                waited += step;
                var st = window.__trkState;
                var tasks = (st && st.tasks) || [];
                var afterIds = tasks.map(function(t) { return t.id; });
                var newId = null;
                var seen = {};
                beforeIds.forEach(function(x) { seen[x] = true; });
                for (var i = 0; i < afterIds.length; i++) {
                    if (!seen[afterIds[i]]) { newId = afterIds[i]; break; }
                }
                if (newId || waited >= 2500) {
                    clearInterval(timer);
                    reopenLogFrom(s, newId);
                }
            }, step);
        });
        obs.observe(taskModal, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (window.__trkLogTaskFromLogV3) return;
    if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
    var logModal = document.getElementById('logModal');
    if (!logModal || !logModal.classList.contains('active')) return;
        var btn = e.target.closest('button');
        if (!btn) return;
        if (!looksLikeCreateTask(btn)) return;
        if (!hasPerm('action.task.create')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return;
        }

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

        var st = window.__trkState;
        var beforeIds = st && st.tasks ? st.tasks.map(function(t) { return t.id; }) : [];
        window.__trkPendingLogState = captureLogState();
        window.__trkPendingLogTaskIdsBefore = beforeIds;

        logModal.classList.remove('active');

        if (typeof window.__trkOpenTaskModal === 'function') {
            window.__trkOpenTaskModal(null);
        } else {
            var alt = document.getElementById('addTaskBtn2') || document.getElementById('addTaskBtn');
            if (alt) alt.click();
        }
    }, true);

    function boot() {
        ensureButton();
        setupTaskModalObserver();
        setTimeout(ensureButton, 700);
        setTimeout(setupTaskModalObserver, 800);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    } else {
        boot();
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
        if (e.target.closest('#dayAddBtn')) {
            setTimeout(ensureButton, 200);
        }
    });

    window.__trkEnsureLogTaskBtn = ensureButton;
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 2026-10-06 — Чистка дублей кнопки «Новая задача» в карточке отметки
   v2: расширен regex — теперь удаляем также «➕ Задача» (старая формулировка).
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    // PATCH: расширенный regex — добавлен вариант «задача» без слова «нов»
    function looksLikeCreateTask(text) {
        var t = String(text || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!t) return false;
        return /новая\s*задач|создать\s*задач|\+\s*задач|➕\s*задач|добавить\s*задач|задача/i.test(t);
    }

    function cleanup() {
        var logModal = document.getElementById('logModal');
        if (!logModal) return;
        logModal.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b) {
            if (b.id === 'logCreateTaskBtn') return;
            if (b.classList.contains('log-create-task-btn')) return;
            if (!looksLikeCreateTask(b.textContent)) return;
            // Не трогаем кнопки в modal-actions (Отмена/Сохранить)
            if (b.closest('.modal-actions')) return;
            b.remove();
        });
    }

    function attachObserver() {
        var logModal = document.getElementById('logModal');
        if (!logModal || logModal._cleanupHooked) return;
        logModal._cleanupHooked = true;
        var obs = new MutationObserver(function() { cleanup(); });
        obs.observe(logModal, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        cleanup();
    }

    function boot() {
        attachObserver();
        setTimeout(cleanup, 500);
        setTimeout(cleanup, 1500);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    } else {
        boot();
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
        if (e.target.closest('#dayAddBtn')) setTimeout(cleanup, 200);
    });

    window.__trkCleanupLogTaskBtns = cleanup;
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 2026-10-06 — V3: единый обработчик «Новая задача» из карточки отметки
   v2: расширен regex — подхватывает также «➕ Задача».
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    var V3_FLAG = '__trkLogTaskFromLogV3';
    var _state = null;
    var _beforeIds = [];
    var _pollTimer = null;
    var _restoreTimer = null;

    function hasPerm(k) {
        return !!(window.REESTR_PERMS && window.REESTR_PERMS[k]);
    }

    // PATCH: расширен regex — подхватывает «➕ Задача»
    function looksLikeCreateTask(text) {
        var t = String(text || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!t) return false;
        return /новая\s*задач|создать\s*задач|\+\s*задач|➕\s*задач|добавить\s*задач|нов(ая|ую)\s*задач|задача/i.test(t);
    }

    function isOurButton(b) {
        return b.id === 'logCreateTaskBtn' || (b.classList && b.classList.contains('log-create-task-btn'));
    }

    function cleanupButtons() {
        var logModal = document.getElementById('logModal');
        if (!logModal) return;
        logModal.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b) {
            if (isOurButton(b)) return;
            if (!looksLikeCreateTask(b.textContent)) return;
            if (b.closest('.modal-actions')) return;
            b.remove();
        });
    }

    function ensureButton() {
        var logModal = document.getElementById('logModal');
        if (!logModal) return;
        var btn = logModal.querySelector('#logCreateTaskBtn');
        if (!btn) {
            // PATCH: если в HTML уже есть #logCreateTaskBtn (новый tracker.html) — не пересоздаём
            // Если нет — создаём рядом с .log-task-wrap
            var wrap = logModal.querySelector('.log-task-wrap');
            var select = document.getElementById('log_task');
            var anchor = wrap || (select ? select.parentNode : null);
            if (!anchor) return;
            btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.id = 'logCreateTaskBtn';
            btn.className = 'log-create-task-btn';
            btn.textContent = '➕ Новая задача';
            btn.title = 'Создать задачу и вернуться к заполнению отметки';
            if (anchor.parentNode) {
                anchor.parentNode.insertBefore(btn, anchor.nextSibling);
            }
        }
        btn.style.display = hasPerm('action.task.create') ? '' : 'none';
        cleanupButtons();
    }

    function captureLogState() {
        var g = function(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : ''; };
        return {
            id: g('log_id'),
            date: g('log_date'),
            hours: g('log_hours'),
            employee_id: g('log_employee'),
            status: g('log_status'),
            comment: g('log_comment'),
            link: g('log_link'),
            task_id: g('log_task')
        };
    }

    function reopenLogFrom(s, newTaskId) {
        if (!s) return;
        var fake = {
            id: s.id || null,
            employee_id: s.employee_id || '',
            task_id: newTaskId || s.task_id || '',
            date: s.date || '',
            hours: parseFloat(s.hours) || 8,
            status: s.status || 'in_progress',
            comment: s.comment || '',
            link: s.link || ''
        };
        if (typeof window.__trkOpenLogModal === 'function') {
            window.__trkOpenLogModal(fake);
            setTimeout(function() {
                var t = document.getElementById('log_task');
                if (t && newTaskId) t.value = newTaskId;
                var h = document.getElementById('log_hours');
                if (h) h.focus();
                ensureButton();
                if (window.__trkDayWasOpenForLogV3) {
                    var _dm = document.getElementById('dayModal');
                    if (_dm) _dm.classList.add('active');
                    window.__trkDayWasOpenForLogV3 = false;
                }
            }, 80);
        }
    }

    function findNewTaskId(beforeIds) {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        var tasks = (st && st.tasks) || [];
        var seen = {};
        beforeIds.forEach(function(x) { seen[x] = true; });
        for (var i = 0; i < tasks.length; i++) {
            if (!seen[tasks[i].id]) return tasks[i].id;
        }
        return null;
    }

    function tryRestore(ctx) {
        if (_restoreTimer) { clearInterval(_restoreTimer); _restoreTimer = null; }
        var waited = 0;
        var step = 150;
        _restoreTimer = setInterval(function() {
            waited += step;
            var newId = findNewTaskId(ctx.beforeIds);
            if (newId || waited >= 2500) {
                clearInterval(_restoreTimer); _restoreTimer = null;
                reopenLogFrom(ctx.state, newId);
            }
        }, step);
    }

    function startWaiting(logState, beforeIds) {
        if (_pollTimer) { clearInterval(_pollTimer); _pollTimer = null; }
        if (_restoreTimer) { clearInterval(_restoreTimer); _restoreTimer = null; }
        _state = logState;
        _beforeIds = beforeIds;

        var taskModal = document.getElementById('taskModal');
        if (!taskModal) return;

        var sawActive = false;
        var startedAt = Date.now();

        _pollTimer = setInterval(function() {
            var isActive = taskModal.classList.contains('active');
            if (!sawActive) {
                if (isActive) {
                    sawActive = true;
                } else if (Date.now() - startedAt > 3000) {
                    clearInterval(_pollTimer); _pollTimer = null;
                    var s = _state; _state = null; _beforeIds = [];
                    if (s) reopenLogFrom(s, null);
                }
                return;
            }
            if (!isActive) {
                clearInterval(_pollTimer); _pollTimer = null;
                var ctxState = _state;
                var ctxIds = _beforeIds;
                _state = null; _beforeIds = [];
                setTimeout(function() { tryRestore({ state: ctxState, beforeIds: ctxIds }); }, 400);
            } else if (Date.now() - startedAt > 5 * 60000) {
                clearInterval(_pollTimer); _pollTimer = null;
                _state = null; _beforeIds = [];
            }
        }, 200);
    }

    window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
        var logModal = document.getElementById('logModal');
        if (!logModal || !logModal.classList.contains('active')) return;
        var btn = e.target.closest('button');
        if (!btn) return;
        if (!isOurButton(btn) && !looksLikeCreateTask(btn.textContent)) return;

        if (!hasPerm('action.task.create')) {
            window[V3_FLAG] = true;
            setTimeout(function() { window[V3_FLAG] = false; }, 500);
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return;
        }

        window[V3_FLAG] = true;
        setTimeout(function() { window[V3_FLAG] = false; }, 500);

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

        if (window.__trkOpeningTaskFromLogV3) return;
        window.__trkOpeningTaskFromLogV3 = true;
        setTimeout(function() { window.__trkOpeningTaskFromLogV3 = false; }, 800);

        window.__trkPendingLogState = null;
        window.__trkPendingDayReopen = null;

        var st = window.__trkState;
        var beforeIds = st && st.tasks ? st.tasks.map(function(t) { return t.id; }) : [];
        var logState = captureLogState();

        var _dayModal = document.getElementById('dayModal');
        var _dayWasOpen = _dayModal && _dayModal.classList.contains('active');
        window.__trkDayWasOpenForLogV3 = _dayWasOpen;
        if (_dayWasOpen) _dayModal.classList.remove('active');

        logModal.classList.remove('active');

        if (typeof window.__trkOpenTaskModal === 'function') {
            window.__trkOpenTaskModal(null);
        } else {
            var alt = document.getElementById('addTaskBtn2') || document.getElementById('addTaskBtn');
            if (alt) alt.click();
        }

        startWaiting(logState, beforeIds);
    }, true);

    function attachObserver() {
        var logModal = document.getElementById('logModal');
        if (!logModal || logModal._v3Hooked) return;
        logModal._v3Hooked = true;
        var obs = new MutationObserver(function() {
            if (logModal.classList.contains('active')) {
                ensureButton();
            }
        });
        obs.observe(logModal, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    }

    function boot() {
        attachObserver();
        setTimeout(ensureButton, 400);
        setTimeout(ensureButton, 1200);
        setTimeout(cleanupButtons, 2000);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    } else {
        boot();
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
        if (e.target.closest('#dayAddBtn')) {
            setTimeout(ensureButton, 200);
            setTimeout(cleanupButtons, 400);
        }
    });

    window.__trkEnsureLogTaskBtnV3 = ensureButton;
})();

   PATCH 05 — Минимум 0.5 ч. Диалог переработки полностью 
   удалён — его заменяет PATCH 07. Раньше перехват fetch здесь

    'use strict';

    function setMin() {
        var h = document.getElementById('log_hours');
        if (h) { h.min = '0.5'; h.step = '0.25'; }
    }
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setMin);

        setMin();
    }
    setTimeout(setMin, 500);
