})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 07 — Модалка переработки v2 (единственный перехватчик 
   fetch для log/save — PATCH 05 уже удалён).
   PATCH v3: inline z-index 9000 для гарантии поверх logModal 
   независимо от CSS-каскада и кеша.
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    var SESSION_KEY = 'tracker_overflow_choice_v2';

    function getStored() {
        try { return sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY) || ''; }
        catch (e) { return ''; }
    }
    function setStored(v) {
        try {
            if (v) sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, v);
            else sessionStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY);
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function setMin() {
        var h = document.getElementById('log_hours');
        if (h) { h.min = '0.5'; h.step = '0.25'; }
    }
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setMin);
    } else { setMin(); }
    setTimeout(setMin, 400);
    setTimeout(setMin, 1200);

    function getModal() {
        var m = document.getElementById('trkOverflowModal');
        if (m) return m;
        m = document.createElement('div');
        m.id = 'trkOverflowModal';
        m.className = 'modal trk-overflow-modal';
        // PATCH v3: inline z-index 9000 с !important — гарантированно 
        // поверх любой модалки (logModal = 5000, taskModal = 5500, карточки = 5300).
        m.style.setProperty('z-index', '9000', 'important');
        m.innerHTML = [
            '<div class="modal-content ov-modal">',
            '  <div class="ov-head">',
            '    <span class="ov-icon">⚠</span>',
            '    <div class="ov-title-block">',
            '      <div class="ov-title">Превышение 8 часов за день</div>',
            '      <div class="ov-sub" id="trkOvSub"></div>',
            '    </div>',
            '  </div>',
            '  <div class="ov-numbers" id="trkOvNumbers"></div>',
            '  <div class="ov-note">',
            '    <b>Принять</b> — сохранить как введено. <b>Распределить</b> — поделить 8 часов между всеми задачами дня поровну.',
            '  </div>',
            '  <label class="ov-remember">',
            '    <input type="checkbox" id="trkOvRemember">',
            '    <span>Запомнить выбор на эту сессию</span>',
            '  </label>',
            '  <div class="ov-forget" id="trkOvForgetWrap" style="display:none;">',
            '    Сохранено: <b id="trkOvForgetVal"></b> · <a href="#" id="trkOvForget">забыть</a>',
            '  </div>',
            '  <div class="ov-actions">',
            '    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-ov="cancel">Отмена</button>',
            '    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-ov="distribute">Распределить поровну</button>',
            '    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-ov="accept">Принять переработку</button>',
            '  </div>',
            '</div>'
        ].join('');
        document.body.appendChild(m);
		m.style.setProperty('z-index', '9000', 'important');
        return m;
    }

    function syncForget(m) {
        var stored = getStored();
        var wrap = m.querySelector('#trkOvForgetWrap');
        var valEl = m.querySelector('#trkOvForgetVal');
        if (!wrap || !valEl) return;
        if (stored) {
            wrap.style.display = '';
            valEl.textContent = stored === 'accept' ? 'принять переработку' : 'распределить поровну';
        } else {
            wrap.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    function showDialog(info) {
        return new Promise(function(resolve) {
            var m = getModal();
            // PATCH v3: при каждом показе гарантируем inline z-index (вдруг кто-то перезаписал)
            m.style.setProperty('z-index', '9000', 'important');
            var sub = m.querySelector('#trkOvSub');
            var nums = m.querySelector('#trkOvNumbers');
            var remember = m.querySelector('#trkOvRemember');

            if (sub) sub.textContent = (info.employee_name || 'Сотрудник') + ' · ' + (info.date || '');

            var over = info.total - 8;
            var fh = function(x) {
                var v = Math.round(x * 100) / 100;
                return (v === Math.floor(v) ? v : v.toFixed(2).replace(/0+$/, '').replace(/\.$/, '')) + ' ч';
            };
            nums.innerHTML = [
                '<div class="ov-num-row"><span class="ov-num-label">Уже за день</span><span class="ov-num-val">' + fh(info.sum_existing) + '</span></div>',
                '<div class="ov-num-row"><span class="ov-num-label">Новая отметка</span><span class="ov-num-val">' + fh(info.new_hours) + '</span></div>',
                '<div class="ov-num-sep"></div>',
                '<div class="ov-num-row ov-num-total"><span class="ov-num-label">Итого будет</span><span class="ov-num-val ov-danger">' + fh(info.total) + '</span></div>',
                '<div class="ov-num-row ov-num-warn"><span class="ov-num-label">Переработка</span><span class="ov-num-val">' + fh(over) + '</span></div>'
            ].join('');

            syncForget(m);
            if (remember) remember.checked = !!getStored();

            var forget = m.querySelector('#trkOvForget');
            if (forget) forget.onclick = function(ev) {
                ev.preventDefault();
                setStored('');
                syncForget(m);
                if (remember) remember.checked = false;
            };

            m.classList.add('active');
            var resolved = false;
            function finish(choice) {
                if (resolved) return;
                resolved = true;
                m.classList.remove('active');
                m.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
                if (choice !== 'cancel' && remember && remember.checked) {
                    setStored(choice);
                } else if (remember && !remember.checked) {
                    setStored('');
                }
                resolve(choice);
            }
            function onClick(e) {
                if (e.target === m) { finish('cancel'); return; }
                var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-ov]');
                if (!b) return;
                finish(b.getAttribute('data-ov'));
            }
            m.addEventListener('click', onClick);
        });
    }

    function parseErr(status, body, wantHours) {
        if (!body) return null;
        if (status === 409 && body.error === 'daily_overflow') return body;
        if (status === 400 && typeof body.error === 'string' && body.error.indexOf('Лимит 8') !== -1) {
            var m1 = body.error.match(/Уже занято:\s*([\d.,]+)/);
            var se = m1 ? parseFloat(m1[1]) : 0;
            return {
                error: 'daily_overflow',
                sum_existing: se,
                new_hours: wantHours,
                total: se + wantHours,
                employee_name: '',
                date: ''
            };
        }
        return null;
    }

    // PATCH v3: единственный перехватчик fetch для log/save.
    // Никакого _prevFetch — используем только нативный fetch.
    var _nativeFetch = window.fetch;
    if (_nativeFetch && !window.__trkOverflowModalV2) {
        window.__trkOverflowModalV2 = true;
        window.fetch = function(url, opts) {
            if (typeof url !== 'string' || url.indexOf('/api/tracker/log/save') === -1) {
                return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments);
            }
            if (!opts || (opts.method || 'GET').toUpperCase() !== 'POST') {
                return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments);
            }
            var wantHours = 0;
            try { wantHours = parseFloat(JSON.parse(opts.body || '{}').hours) || 0; } catch (e) {}

            var self = this;
            return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments).then(function(resp) {
                if (resp.status !== 409 && resp.status !== 400) return resp;
                return resp.clone().json().then(function(d) {
                    var info = parseErr(resp.status, d, wantHours);
                    if (!info) {
                        return new Response(JSON.stringify(d || {success:false}), {
                            status: resp.status,
                            headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
                        });
                    }
                    if (!info.employee_name) {
                        try {
                            var st = window.__trkState;
                            var body = JSON.parse(opts.body || '{}');
                            if (st && st.employees && body.employee_id) {
                                var emp = st.employees.find(function(e) { return e.id === body.employee_id; });
                                if (emp) info.employee_name = emp.name;
                            }
                            if (!info.date) info.date = body.date || '';
                        } catch (e) {}
                    }

                    var stored = getStored();
                    var choiceP = (stored === 'accept' || stored === 'distribute')
                        ? Promise.resolve(stored)
                        : showDialog(info);

                    return choiceP.then(function(choice) {
                        if (choice === 'cancel') {
                            return new Response(JSON.stringify({
                                success: false,
                                error: 'cancelled'
                            }), { status: 200, headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} });
                        }
                        var payload;
                        try { payload = JSON.parse(opts.body || '{}'); } catch (e) { payload = {}; }
                        payload.overflow_action = (choice === 'accept') ? 'accept' : 'distribute';
                        var newOpts = Object.assign({}, opts, { body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
                        return _nativeFetch.call(self, url, newOpts);
                    });
                });
            });
        };
    }
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 08 — Удаление отметки с перераспределением часов
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    function esc(s) {
        return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c) {
            return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];
        });
    }
    function fmtH(x) {
        var v = Math.round((Number(x) || 0) * 100) / 100;
        if (v === Math.floor(v)) return v + ' ч';
        return v.toFixed(2).replace(/0+$/, '').replace(/\.$/, '') + ' ч';
    }

    function getModal() {
        var m = document.getElementById('trkDeleteLogModal');
        if (m) return m;
        m = document.createElement('div');
        m.id = 'trkDeleteLogModal';
        m.className = 'modal trk-del-log-modal';
        // PATCH v3: inline z-index — гарантированно поверх logModal
        m.style.setProperty('z-index', '9000', 'important');
        m.innerHTML = [
            '<div class="modal-content dl-modal">',
            '  <div class="dl-head">',
            '    <span class="dl-icon">🗑</span>',
            '    <div class="dl-title-block">',
            '      <div class="dl-title">Удалить отметку?</div>',
            '      <div class="dl-sub" id="trkDlSub"></div>',
            '    </div>',
            '  </div>',
            '  <div class="dl-info" id="trkDlInfo"></div>',
            '  <div class="dl-question" id="trkDlQuestion"></div>',
            '  <div class="dl-actions">',
            '    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-dl="cancel">Отмена</button>',
            '    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-dl="keep">Оставить как есть</button>',
            '    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-dl="redistribute">Перераспределить поровну</button>',
            '  </div>',
            '</div>'
        ].join('');
        document.body.appendChild(m);
		m.style.setProperty('z-index', '9000', 'important');
        return m;
    }

    function showDialog(info) {
        return new Promise(function(resolve) {
            var m = getModal();
            var sub = m.querySelector('#trkDlSub');
            var infoEl = m.querySelector('#trkDlInfo');
            var qEl = m.querySelector('#trkDlQuestion');
            if (sub) sub.textContent = (info.employee_name || '') + ' · ' + (info.date || '');
            if (infoEl) {
                infoEl.innerHTML = [
                    '<div class="dl-row"><span class="dl-label">Задача</span><span class="dl-val">' + esc(info.task_name || '') + '</span></div>',
                    '<div class="dl-row"><span class="dl-label">Часы</span><span class="dl-val dl-danger">' + fmtH(info.hours) + '</span></div>'
                ].join('');
            }
            if (qEl) {
                qEl.innerHTML = 'У сотрудника остаётся <b>' + info.remaining.length + '</b> задач(и) на <b>' +
                    fmtH(info.remaining_hours) + '</b>.<br>' +
                    'Что сделать с освободившимися <b>' + fmtH(info.hours) + '</b>?';
            }
			m.style.setProperty('z-index', '9000', 'important');
            m.classList.add('active');
            var resolved = false;
            function finish(choice) {
                if (resolved) return;
                resolved = true;
                m.classList.remove('active');
                m.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
                resolve(choice);
            }
            function onClick(e) {
                if (e.target === m) { finish('cancel'); return; }
                var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-dl]');
                if (!b) return;
                finish(b.getAttribute('data-dl'));
            }
            m.addEventListener('click', onClick);
        });
    }

    function findInfo(logId) {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st || !st.calendar || !st.calendar.days) return null;
        for (var i = 0; i < st.calendar.days.length; i++) {
            var day = st.calendar.days[i];
            var entries = day.entries || [];
            var target = null;
            for (var j = 0; j < entries.length; j++) {
                if (entries[j].id === logId) { target = entries[j]; break; }
            }
            if (!target) continue;
            var empId = target.employee_id;
            var same = entries.filter(function(e) {
                return e.employee_id === empId && e.id !== logId;
            });
            var remH = same.reduce(function(s, e) { return s + (parseFloat(e.hours) || 0); }, 0);
            var totalB = remH + (parseFloat(target.hours) || 0);
            return {
                entry: target,
                date: day.date,
                employee_id: empId,
                employee_name: target.employee_name,
                task_name: target.task_name,
                hours: parseFloat(target.hours) || 0,
                remaining: same,
                remaining_hours: remH,
                total_before: totalB
            };
        }
        return null;
    }

    function distribute(total, n) {
        if (n < 1) return [];
        var each = Math.floor((total / n) * 4) / 4;
        if (each < 0.25) each = 0.25;
        var out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) out.push(each);
        var last = Math.round((total - each * (n - 1)) * 4) / 4;
        if (last < 0.25) last = 0.25;
        out.push(last);
        return out;
    }

    var _nativeFetch = window.fetch;
    if (_nativeFetch && !window.__trkDeleteLogModalV1) {
        window.__trkDeleteLogModalV1 = true;
        window.fetch = function(url, opts) {
            if (typeof url !== 'string' || url.indexOf('/api/tracker/log/delete') === -1) {
                return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments);
            }
            if (!opts || (opts.method || 'GET').toUpperCase() !== 'POST') {
                return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments);
            }
            var logId = 0;
            try { logId = parseInt(JSON.parse(opts.body || '{}').id, 10); } catch (e) {}
            if (!logId) return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments);

            var info = findInfo(logId);
            if (!info || !info.remaining.length) {
                return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments);
            }

            var self = this;
            return showDialog(info).then(function(choice) {
                if (choice === 'cancel') {
                    return new Response(JSON.stringify({
                        success: false,
                        error: 'cancelled'
                    }), { status: 200, headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} });
                }
                return _nativeFetch.call(self, url, opts).then(function(r) {
                    if (!r.ok) return r;
                    if (choice !== 'redistribute') return r;
                    var ids = info.remaining.map(function(e) { return e.id; });
                    var vals = distribute(info.total_before, ids.length);
                    var chain = Promise.resolve();
                    info.remaining.forEach(function(e, i) {
                        chain = chain.then(function() {
                            var newH = vals[i];
                            if (Math.abs(newH - (parseFloat(e.hours) || 0)) < 0.01) return null;
                            var hdrs = Object.assign({}, opts.headers || {}, {'Content-Type': 'application/json'});
                            return _nativeFetch('/api/tracker/log/save', {
                                method: 'POST',
                                headers: hdrs,
                                credentials: 'same-origin',
                                body: JSON.stringify({
                                    id: e.id,
                                    employee_id: e.employee_id,
                                    task_id: e.task_id,
                                    date: e.date,
                                    hours: newH,
                                    status: e.status || 'in_progress',
                                    comment: e.comment || '',
                                    link: e.link || '',
                                    overflow_action: 'accept'
                                })
                            });
                        });
                    });
                    return chain.then(function() { return r; });
                });
            });
        };
    }
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 10 — Должности: автозаполнение списка
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    function fillRoleDatalist() {
        var dl = document.getElementById('emp_role_list');
        if (!dl) return;
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st || !st.employees) return;
        var seen = {};
        st.employees.forEach(function(e) {
            var r = (e.role || '').trim();
            if (r) seen[r] = true;
        });
        var roles = Object.keys(seen).sort(function(a, b) {
            return a.toLowerCase().localeCompare(b.toLowerCase());
        });
        dl.innerHTML = roles.map(function(r) {
            return '<option value="' + r.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') + '"></option>';
        }).join('');
    }

    function attachObserver() {
        var m = document.getElementById('employeeModal');
        if (!m || m._roleDatalistHooked) return;
        m._roleDatalistHooked = true;
        var obs = new MutationObserver(function() {
            if (m.classList.contains('active')) fillRoleDatalist();
        });
        obs.observe(m, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
    }

    function boot() {
        attachObserver();
        setTimeout(fillRoleDatalist, 800);
        setTimeout(fillRoleDatalist, 2000);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    } else {
        boot();
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!e.target || !e.target.closest) return;
        if (e.target.closest('#addEmployeeBtn')) setTimeout(fillRoleDatalist, 80);
    });

    window.__trkFillRoleDatalist = fillRoleDatalist;
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 14 — Вид «Сотрудники» v2: missing + редактирование + многострочность
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    function _esc(s) {
        return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c) {
            return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];
        });
    }
    function _initials(name) {
        var parts = String(name || '').trim().split(/\s+/);
        if (!parts.length) return '?';
        if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
        return (parts[0][0] + (parts[1][0] || '')).toUpperCase();
    }
    function _fmtH(h) {
        h = Number(h) || 0;
        if (h === Math.floor(h)) return h + ' ч';
        return h.toFixed(2).replace(/0+$/, '').replace(/\.$/, '') + ' ч';
    }
    function _maskName(name) {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st || !st.maskNames) return name;
        return String(name == null ? '' : name).split(/\s+/).map(function(w) {
            if (w.length <= 1) return w;
            return w[0] + new Array(w.length).join('*');
        }).join(' ');
    }
    function _isMine(en) {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        var me = (st && st.currentUser) || {};
        if (!me.employee_id) return false;
        return en.employee_id === me.employee_id;
    }
    function _canEdit(en) {
        if (window.REESTR_PERMS && window.REESTR_PERMS['action.log.edit.any']) return true;
        if (window.REESTR_PERMS && window.REESTR_PERMS['action.log.edit.own'] && _isMine(en)) return true;
        return false;
    }
    function _canDelete(en) {
        if (window.REESTR_PERMS && window.REESTR_PERMS['action.log.delete.any']) return true;
        if (window.REESTR_PERMS && window.REESTR_PERMS['action.log.delete.own'] && _isMine(en)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    function _renderMissing(day) {
        var mb = document.getElementById('dayMissingBlock');
        if (!mb) return;
        if (day && day.missing && day.missing.length) {
            mb.style.display = 'block';
            var items = day.missing.map(function(m) {
                return '<span class="dm-item">'
                    + '<span class="dm-dot" style="background:' + _esc(m.color) + '; box-shadow:0 0 6px ' + _esc(m.color) + ';"></span>'
                    + _esc(_maskName(m.name))
                    + (m.department ? ' <span style="opacity:0.7;font-size:0.72rem;">(' + _esc(m.department) + ')</span>' : '')
                    + '</span>';
            }).join('');
            mb.innerHTML = '<div class="dm-title">⚠ Не заполнили день (' + day.missing.length + '):</div>'
                + '<div class="dm-list">' + items + '</div>';
        } else {
            mb.style.display = 'none';
            mb.innerHTML = '';
        }
    }

    window.__trkRenderDayByEmployee = function(entries, totalHours, day) {
        var listEl = document.getElementById('dayList');
        if (!listEl) return false;

        _renderMissing(day);

        if (!entries || !entries.length) {
            listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="day-empty">За этот день отметок нет.</div>';
            return true;
        }

        var byEmp = {};
        entries.forEach(function(en) {
            var eid = en.employee_id || '?';
            if (!byEmp[eid]) {
                byEmp[eid] = {
                    id: eid,
                    name: en.employee_name || '',
                    color: en.employee_color || '#888',
                    dept: en.employee_department || '',
                    tasks: [],
                    total: 0
                };
            }
            byEmp[eid].tasks.push(en);
            byEmp[eid].total += parseFloat(en.hours) || 0;
        });

        var emps = Object.keys(byEmp).map(function(k) { return byEmp[k]; });
        emps.sort(function(a, b) { return b.total - a.total; });

        var html = '<div class="day-emp-tiles">';
        emps.forEach(function(e) {
            var bg = _esc(e.color);
            html += '<div class="day-emp-tile" style="--det-accent:' + bg + ';">'
                + '<div class="det-head">'
                +   '<div class="det-avatar" style="background:' + bg + ';">' + _esc(_initials(e.name)) + '</div>'
                +   '<div class="det-meta">'
                +     '<div class="det-name">' + _esc(_maskName(e.name)) + '</div>'
                +     (e.dept ? '<div class="det-dept">🏢 ' + _esc(e.dept) + '</div>' : '')
                +   '</div>'
                +   '<div class="det-total">' + _fmtH(e.total) + '</div>'
                + '</div>'
                + '<div class="det-tasks">';

            e.tasks.sort(function(a, b) { return (parseFloat(b.hours) || 0) - (parseFloat(a.hours) || 0); });
            e.tasks.forEach(function(en) {
                var ed = _canEdit(en);
                var dl = _canDelete(en);
                html += '<div class="det-task" data-id="' + en.id + '">'
                    + '<span class="det-task-ico">' + _esc(en.task_icon || '📋') + '</span>'
                    + '<div class="det-task-body">'
                    +   '<div class="det-task-name' + (en.overdue ? ' overdue' : '') + '">' + _esc(en.task_name || '') + '</div>'
                    +   (en.comment ? '<div class="det-task-comment">' + _esc(en.comment) + '</div>' : '')
                    + '</div>'
                    + '<span class="det-task-hours">' + _fmtH(en.hours) + '</span>'
                    + '<span class="det-task-actions">'
                    +   (ed ? '<button type="button" class="dict-action-btn" data-act="edit" title="Редактировать">✏️</button>' : '')
                    +   (dl ? '<button type="button" class="dict-action-btn danger" data-act="delete" title="Удалить">🗑</button>' : '')
                    + '</span>'
                    + '</div>';
            });
            html += '</div></div>';
        });
        html += '</div>';
        listEl.innerHTML = html;

        if (typeof window.__trkBindDayEntryActions === 'function') {
            try { window.__trkBindDayEntryActions(listEl, entries); } catch (e) { console.error('[day-view-v2]', e); }
        }
        return true;
    };
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 15 — Дневная карточка: выбор числа колонок I/II
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    var KEY = 'tracker_day_cols';

    function getSaved() {
        try {
            var v = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(KEY), 10);
            if (v >= 1 && v <= 4) return v;
        } catch (e) {}
        return 1;
    }

    function syncPicker(cols) {
        var p = document.getElementById('dayColsPicker');
        if (!p) return;
        p.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b) {
            b.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-cols'), 10) === cols);
        });
    }

    function apply(cols) {
        if (!(cols >= 1 && cols <= 4)) cols = 1;
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (st) st.dayCols = cols;
        try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, String(cols)); } catch (e) {}
        var list = document.getElementById('dayList');
        if (list) {

/* ============================================================
   PATCH 17 — Вид «Сотрудники» v3: маркер статуса + уменьшенный шрифт
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    function _esc(s) {
        return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c) {
            return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];
        });
    }
    function _initials(name) {
        var parts = String(name || '').trim().split(/\s+/);
        if (!parts.length) return '?';
        if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
        return (parts[0][0] + (parts[1][0] || '')).toUpperCase();
    }
    function _fmtH(h) {
        h = Number(h) || 0;
        if (h === Math.floor(h)) return h + ' ч';
        return h.toFixed(2).replace(/0+$/, '').replace(/\.$/, '') + ' ч';
    }
    function _maskName(name) {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st || !st.maskNames) return name;
        return String(name == null ? '' : name).split(/\s+/).map(function(w) {
            if (w.length <= 1) return w;
            return w[0] + new Array(w.length).join('*');
        }).join(' ');
    }
    function _isMine(en) {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        var me = (st && st.currentUser) || {};
        if (!me.employee_id) return false;
        return en.employee_id === me.employee_id;
    }
    function _canEdit(en) {
        if (window.REESTR_PERMS && window.REESTR_PERMS['action.log.edit.any']) return true;
        if (window.REESTR_PERMS && window.REESTR_PERMS['action.log.edit.own'] && _isMine(en)) return true;
        return false;
    }
    function _canDelete(en) {
        if (window.REESTR_PERMS && window.REESTR_PERMS['action.log.delete.any']) return true;
        if (window.REESTR_PERMS && window.REESTR_PERMS['action.log.delete.own'] && _isMine(en)) return true;
        return false;
    }
    function _statusInfo(en) {
        var st = (en && en.status) || 'in_progress';
        var lbl = (en && en.status_label) || '';
        if (!lbl) {
            var map = {
                done:        '✅ Готово',
                in_progress: '🔵 В работе',
                planned:     '📝 Запланировано',
                blocked:     '🔴 Заблокировано'
            };
            lbl = map[st] || st;
        }
        return { key: st, label: lbl };
    }

    function _renderMissing(day) {
        var mb = document.getElementById('dayMissingBlock');
        if (!mb) return;
        if (day && day.missing && day.missing.length) {
            mb.style.display = 'block';
            var items = day.missing.map(function(m) {
                return '<span class="dm-item">'
                    + '<span class="dm-dot" style="background:' + _esc(m.color) + '; box-shadow:0 0 6px ' + _esc(m.color) + ';"></span>'
                    + _esc(_maskName(m.name))
                    + (m.department ? ' <span style="opacity:0.7;font-size:0.72rem;">(' + _esc(m.department) + ')</span>' : '')
                    + '</span>';
            }).join('');
            mb.innerHTML = '<div class="dm-title">⚠ Не заполнили день (' + day.missing.length + '):</div>'
                + '<div class="dm-list">' + items + '</div>';
        } else {
            mb.style.display = 'none';
            mb.innerHTML = '';
        }
    }

    window.__trkRenderDayByEmployee = function(entries, totalHours, day) {
        var listEl = document.getElementById('dayList');
        if (!listEl) return false;

        _renderMissing(day);

        if (!entries || !entries.length) {
            listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="day-empty">За этот день отметок нет.</div>';
            return true;
        }

        var byEmp = {};
        entries.forEach(function(en) {
            var eid = en.employee_id || '?';
            if (!byEmp[eid]) {
                byEmp[eid] = {
                    id: eid,
                    name: en.employee_name || '',
                    color: en.employee_color || '#888',
                    dept: en.employee_department || '',
                    tasks: [],
                    total: 0
                };
            }
            byEmp[eid].tasks.push(en);
            byEmp[eid].total += parseFloat(en.hours) || 0;
        });

        var emps = Object.keys(byEmp).map(function(k) { return byEmp[k]; });
        emps.sort(function(a, b) { return b.total - a.total; });

        var html = '<div class="day-emp-tiles">';
        emps.forEach(function(e) {
            var bg = _esc(e.color);
            html += '<div class="day-emp-tile" style="--det-accent:' + bg + ';">'
                + '<div class="det-head">'
                +   '<div class="det-avatar" style="background:' + bg + ';">' + _esc(_initials(e.name)) + '</div>'
                +   '<div class="det-meta">'
                +     '<div class="det-name">' + _esc(_maskName(e.name)) + '</div>'
                +     (e.dept ? '<div class="det-dept">🏢 ' + _esc(e.dept) + '</div>' : '')
                +   '</div>'
                +   '<div class="det-total">' + _fmtH(e.total) + '</div>'
                + '</div>'
                + '<div class="det-tasks">';

            e.tasks.sort(function(a, b) { return (parseFloat(b.hours) || 0) - (parseFloat(a.hours) || 0); });
            e.tasks.forEach(function(en) {
                var ed = _canEdit(en);
                var dl = _canDelete(en);
                var st = _statusInfo(en);
                html += '<div class="det-task" data-id="' + en.id + '">'
                    + '<span class="det-task-ico">' + _esc(en.task_icon || '📋') + '</span>'
                    + '<div class="det-task-body">'
                    +   '<div class="det-task-title">'
                    +     '<span class="det-task-status st-' + _esc(st.key) + '" title="' + _esc(st.label) + '"></span>'
                    +     '<span class="det-task-name' + (en.overdue ? ' overdue' : '') + '">' + _esc(en.task_name || '') + '</span>'
                    +   '</div>'
                    +   (en.comment ? '<div class="det-task-comment">' + _esc(en.comment) + '</div>' : '')
                    + '</div>'
                    + '<span class="det-task-hours">' + _fmtH(en.hours) + '</span>'
                    + '<span class="det-task-actions">'
                    +   (ed ? '<button type="button" class="dict-action-btn" data-act="edit" title="Редактировать">✏️</button>' : '')
                    +   (dl ? '<button type="button" class="dict-action-btn danger" data-act="delete" title="Удалить">🗑</button>' : '')
                    + '</span>'
                    + '</div>';
            });
            html += '</div></div>';
        });
        html += '</div>';
        listEl.innerHTML = html;

        if (typeof window.__trkBindDayEntryActions === 'function') {
            try { window.__trkBindDayEntryActions(listEl, entries); } catch (e) { console.error('[day-view-v3]', e); }
        }
        return true;
    };
})();

    function _esc(s) {

            return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];
        });
    }

    function getModal() {
        var m = document.getElementById('trkDupTaskModal');
        if (m) return m;
        m = document.createElement('div');
        m.id = 'trkDupTaskModal';
        m.className = 'modal trk-dup-task-modal';
        m.innerHTML = [
            '<div class="modal-content dt-modal">',
            '  <div class="dt-head">',

            '    </div>',

            '  <div class="dt-body" id="trkDupBody"></div>',
            '  <div class="dt-actions">',
            '    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-dt="cancel">Отмена</button>',
            '    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-dt="open">Открыть существующую</button>',
            '    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-dt="force">Всё равно создать</button>',
            '  </div>',
            '</div>'
        ].join('');
        document.body.appendChild(m);
		m.style.setProperty('z-index', '9000', 'important');
        return m;
    }

    function showDupDialog(data) {
        return new Promise(function(resolve) {
            var m = getModal();
            var body = m.querySelector('#trkDupBody');
            var html = '';
            if (data.exact) {
                html += '<div class="dt-exact">'
                     + '<div class="dt-exact-lbl">Точное совпадение:</div>'
                     + '<div class="dt-exact-name">' + _esc(data.exact.name) + '</div>'
                     + '</div>';
            }
            if (data.similar && data.similar.length) {
                html += '<div class="dt-similar">'
                     + '<div class="dt-sim-lbl">Похожие задачи:</div>'
                     + data.similar.map(function(t) {
                         return '<div class="dt-sim-row"><span class="dt-sim-name">' + _esc(t.name) + '</span>'
                              + '<button type="button" class="dt-sim-open" data-id="' + _esc(t.id) + '">открыть</button></div>';
                     }).join('')
                     + '</div>';
            }
            body.innerHTML = html;

            m.classList.add('active');
            var resolved = false;
            function finish(choice, tid) {
                if (resolved) return;
                resolved = true;
                m.classList.remove('active');
                m.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
                resolve({ choice: choice, id: tid || '' });
            }
            function onClick(e) {
                if (e.target === m) { finish('cancel'); return; }
                var openBtn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.dt-sim-open');
                if (openBtn) {
                    finish('open', openBtn.getAttribute('data-id'));
                    return;
                }
                var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-dt]');
                if (!b) return;
                finish(b.getAttribute('data-dt'));
            }
            m.addEventListener('click', onClick);
        });
    }

        window.__trkDupTaskModalV1 = true;
        window.fetch = function(url, opts) {

            if (!opts || (opts.method || 'GET').toUpperCase() !== 'POST') {

            var self = this;
            return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments).then(function(r) {
                if (r.status !== 409) return r;
                return r.clone().json().then(function(d) {
                    if (!d || d.error !== 'duplicate_name') return r;
                    return showDupDialog(d).then(function(res) {

                            return new Response(JSON.stringify({
                                success: false, error: 'cancelled'
                            }), { status: 200, headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} });
                        }
                        if (res.choice === 'open') {
                            var tid = res.id || (d.exact && d.exact.id) || (d.similar && d.similar[0] && d.similar[0].id);
                            var _st = window.__trkState;
                            var _t = _st && _st.tasks ? _st.tasks.find(function(x) { return x.id === tid; }) : null;
                            if (_t && typeof window.__trkOpenTaskModal === 'function') {
                                window.__trkOpenTaskModal(_t);
                            } else if (window.__trackerNotify) {
                                window.__trackerNotify('Не удалось открыть задачу: не найдена в текущем списке', 'error');
                            }
                            return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, opened: tid }), {
                                status: 200, headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
                            });
                        }
                        var payload;
                        try { payload = JSON.parse(opts.body || '{}'); } catch (e) { payload = {}; }
                        payload.force_duplicate = 1;
                        var newOpts = Object.assign({}, opts, { body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
                        return _nativeFetch.call(self, url, newOpts);
                    });
                });
            });
        };

/* ============================================================
   PATCH 20 — Кнопка «Добавить меня» в дневной карточке
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    function _norm(s) {
        return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }

    function currentDay() {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st || !st.calendar || !st.currentDay) return null;
        return st.calendar.days.find(function(d) { return d.date === st.currentDay; }) || null;
    }

    function hasPerm(k) {
        return !!(window.REESTR_PERMS && window.REESTR_PERMS[k]);
    }

    function decorate() {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st) return;
        if (st.dayViewMode === 'employee') return;
        var me = st.currentUser && st.currentUser.employee_id;
        if (!me) return;
        if (!hasPerm('action.log.create')) return;

        var day = currentDay();
        if (!day) return;

        var myTaskIds = {};
        (day.entries || []).forEach(function(en) {
            if (en.employee_id === me) myTaskIds[en.task_id] = true;
        });

        var list = document.getElementById('dayList');
        if (!list) return;
        list.querySelectorAll('.day-task-group').forEach(function(g) {
            if (g.querySelector('.day-task-addme')) return;
            var titleEl = g.querySelector('.day-task-group-title');
            if (!titleEl) return;
            var txt = _norm(titleEl.textContent || '');
            var matched = null;
            (st.tasks || []).forEach(function(t) {
                if (!t || !t.name) return;
                var nm = _norm(t.name);
                if (nm && txt.indexOf(nm) !== -1) matched = t;
            });
            if (!matched) return;
            if (myTaskIds[matched.id]) return;
            if (matched.status !== 'active' && matched.status !== 'paused') return;

            var btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.type = 'button';
            btn.className = 'day-task-addme';
            btn.textContent = '➕ Добавить меня';
            btn.title = 'Отметиться по этой задаче на этот день';
            btn.setAttribute('data-task-id', matched.id);
            btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                addMe(matched.id);
            });
            var head = g.querySelector('.day-task-group-head');
            if (head) head.appendChild(btn);
        });
    }

    function addMe(taskId) {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st) return;
        var me = st.currentUser && st.currentUser.employee_id;
        var dk = st.currentDay;
        if (!me || !dk) return;

        var day = currentDay();
        var n = 0;
        (day && day.entries || []).forEach(function(en) {
            if (en.employee_id === me) n++;
        });
        var hrs = Math.round((8 / (n + 1)) * 4) / 4;
        if (hrs < 0.5) hrs = 0.5;
        if (hrs > 24) hrs = 24;

        var hdrs = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
        if (window.REESTR_CSRF) hdrs['X-CSRF-Token'] = window.REESTR_CSRF;

        fetch('/api/tracker/log/save', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: hdrs,
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            body: JSON.stringify({
                employee_id: me,
                task_id: taskId,
                date: dk,
                hours: hrs,
                status: 'in_progress',
                comment: 'Добавлено из карточки дня',
                link: ''
            })
        }).then(function(r) {
            return r.json().then(function(d) { return { ok: r.ok, d: d }; });
        }).then(function(res) {
            if (!res.ok || !res.d || !res.d.success) {
                if (res.d && res.d.error && res.d.error !== 'cancelled') {
                    if (typeof window.__trackerNotify === 'function') {
                        window.__trackerNotify('❌ ' + res.d.error, 'error');
                    }
                }
                return;
            }
            var dm = document.getElementById('dayModal');
            if (dm) dm.classList.remove('active');
            // PATCH v1.0.6: обновляем активную вкладку, не только календарь
            var _refresh = (typeof window.__trkRefreshAll === 'function')
                ? window.__trkRefreshAll
                : (typeof window.__trkRenderCalendar === 'function' ? window.__trkRenderCalendar : null);
            if (_refresh) {
                Promise.resolve(_refresh()).then(function() {
                    if (typeof window.__trkOpenDayModal === 'function') {
                        window.__trkOpenDayModal(dk);
                    }
                });
            } else if (typeof window.__trkOpenDayModal === 'function') {
                window.__trkOpenDayModal(dk);
            }
        }).catch(function(err) {
            if (err && err.message && err.message.indexOf('cancelled') !== -1) return;
            if (typeof window.__trackerNotify === 'function') {
                window.__trackerNotify('❌ ' + (err.message || 'Ошибка'), 'error');
            }
        });
    }

    function attachObserver() {
        var m = document.getElementById('dayModal');
        if (!m || m._addMeHooked) return;
        m._addMeHooked = true;
        var obs = new MutationObserver(function() {
            if (m.classList.contains('active')) {
                setTimeout(decorate, 60);
                setTimeout(decorate, 250);
            }
        });
        obs.observe(m, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
        var list = document.getElementById('dayList');
        if (list) {
            var lobs = new MutationObserver(function() { setTimeout(decorate, 30); });
            lobs.observe(list, { childList: true });
        }
    }

    function boot() {
        attachObserver();
        setTimeout(attachObserver, 800);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    } else {
        boot();
    }

    window.__trkDecorateDayAddMe = decorate;
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 21 — Модалка «Задача завершена» при сохранении done
   ============================================================ */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    var PERIODIC_TAG = 'pereodic';
    var _shown = {};

    function _esc(s) {
        return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c) {
            return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];
        });
    }
    function hasPerm(k) {
        return !!(window.REESTR_PERMS && window.REESTR_PERMS[k]);
    }
    function _isPeriodic(t) {
        if (!t || !t.tags) return false;
        return t.tags.indexOf(PERIODIC_TAG) !== -1;
    }

    function analyze(taskId) {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st || !st.tasks) return null;
        var t = st.tasks.find(function(x) { return x.id === taskId; });
        if (!t) return null;

        var assignees = t.assignees || [];
        var lastByEmp = {};
        (st.log || []).forEach(function(l) {
            if (l.task_id !== taskId) return;
            var eid = l.employee_id;
            if (!eid) return;
            var cur = lastByEmp[eid];
            var ld = l.date || '';
            var cd = cur ? (cur.date || '') : '';
            if (!cur || ld > cd || (ld === cd && (l.id || 0) > (cur.id || 0))) {
                lastByEmp[eid] = l;
            }
        });

        var closed = [], open = [];
        assignees.forEach(function(eid) {
            var e = (st.employees || []).find(function(x) { return x.id === eid; });
            var name = e ? e.name : eid;
            var color = e ? (e.color || '#888') : '#888';
            var rec = lastByEmp[eid];
            if (rec && rec.status === 'done') {
                closed.push({ id: eid, name: name, color: color, date: rec.date });
            } else {
                open.push({
                    id: eid, name: name, color: color,
                    status: rec ? (rec.status || 'in_progress') : 'none',
                    date: rec ? (rec.date || '') : ''
                });
            }
        });

        return { task: t, assignees: assignees, closed: closed, open: open, periodic: _isPeriodic(t) };
    }

    function statusLabel(s) {
        return {
            done:        'готово',
            in_progress: 'в работе',
            planned:     'запланировано',
            blocked:     'заблокировано',
            none:        'нет отметок'
        }[s] || s;
    }

    function getModal() {
        var m = document.getElementById('trkDoneModal');
        if (m) return m;

    function renderInfo(a) {
        var html = '';
        html += '<div class="dm-task-name">' + _esc((a.task.icon || '📋') + ' ' + a.task.name) + '</div>';

        if (a.periodic) {

        if (a.open.length === 0) {

            if (a.task.status === 'done' || a.task.status === 'archived') {
                html += '<div class="dm-note dm-note-ok">Задача уже помечена как выполненная.</div>';
            } else {
                html += '<div class="dm-note dm-note-ok">Все отметки закрыты. Пометить задачу как <b>выполненную</b>?</div>';
            }
        } else {
            html += '<div class="dm-partial">Ваша отметка сохранена. У задачи ещё есть незакрытые исполнители:</div>';
            html += '<div class="dm-people">';
            a.open.forEach(function(p) {
                html += '<div class="dm-person dm-open">'
                     + '<span class="dm-dot" style="background:' + _esc(p.color) + ';"></span>'
                     + '<span class="dm-name">' + _esc(p.name) + '</span>'
                     + '<span class="dm-status">' + _esc(statusLabel(p.status)) + (p.date ? ' · ' + _esc(p.date) : '') + '</span>'
                     + '</div>';
            });
            html += '</div>';
            if (a.task.status === 'done' || a.task.status === 'archived') {
                html += '<div class="dm-note">Задача уже отмечена как выполненная, но не все закрыли отметки.</div>';
            }

    }

    function show(a, onCloseChoice) {
        var m = getModal();
        var icon = m.querySelector('#trkDmIcon');
        var title = m.querySelector('#trkDmTitle');
        var sub = m.querySelector('#trkDmSub');
        var body = m.querySelector('#trkDmBody');
        var actions = m.querySelector('#trkDmActions');

        var allClosed = a.open.length === 0;
        var alreadyDone = a.task.status === 'done' || a.task.status === 'archived';

        if (a.periodic) {
            if (icon) icon.textContent = '🔄';
            if (title) title.textContent = 'Задача периодическая';
            if (sub) sub.textContent = 'Отметка сохранена';
        } else if (allClosed) {
            if (icon) icon.textContent = '✅';
            if (title) title.textContent = alreadyDone ? 'Задача уже выполнена' : 'Все исполнители закрыли задачу';
            if (sub) sub.textContent = 'Отметка сохранена';
        } else {
            if (icon) icon.textContent = '📝';
            if (title) title.textContent = 'Отметка сохранена';
            if (sub) sub.textContent = 'Осталось ' + a.open.length + ' незакрытых исполнителей';
        }

        if (body) body.innerHTML = renderInfo(a);

        var btns = [];
        if (!a.periodic && allClosed && !alreadyDone && hasPerm('action.task.edit')) {
            btns.push('<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-dm="close">✅ Закрыть задачу</button>');
        }
        btns.push('<button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-dm="ok">' + (allClosed ? 'Оставить активной' : 'ОК') + '</button>');
        if (actions) actions.innerHTML = btns.join('');

        m.classList.add('active');
        var resolved = false;
        function finish(choice) {
            if (resolved) return;
            resolved = true;
            m.classList.remove('active');
            m.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
            if (typeof onCloseChoice === 'function') onCloseChoice(choice);
        }
        function onClick(e) {
            if (e.target === m) { finish('ok'); return; }
            var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-dm]');
            if (!b) return;
            finish(b.getAttribute('data-dm'));
        }
        m.addEventListener('click', onClick);
    }

    function closeTask(task, onDone) {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st) return;
        var today = (st.today || '').slice(0, 10);
        var payload = {
            id: task.id,
            name: task.name,
            icon: task.icon || '📋',
            description: task.description || '',
            status: 'done',
            start_date: task.start_date || '',
            deadline: task.deadline || '',
            completed_at: today,
            folder: task.folder || '',
            order_ref: task.order_ref || '',
            tags: task.tags || [],
            assignees: task.assignees || [],
            department_ids: task.department_ids || []
        };
        var hdrs = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
        if (window.REESTR_CSRF) hdrs['X-CSRF-Token'] = window.REESTR_CSRF;
        fetch('/api/tracker/task/save', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: hdrs,
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        }).then(function(r) { return r.json(); }).then(function(d) {
            if (!d || !d.success) {
                if (typeof window.__trackerNotify === 'function') {
                    window.__trackerNotify('❌ ' + ((d && d.error) || 'Не удалось закрыть задачу'), 'error');
                }
                return;
            }
            if (typeof window.__trackerNotify === 'function') {
                window.__trackerNotify('✅ Задача закрыта', 'success');
            }
            if (typeof window.__trkLoadState === 'function') {
                try { window.__trkLoadState(); } catch (e) {}
            }
            if (typeof onDone === 'function') onDone();
        }).catch(function(err) {
            if (typeof window.__trackerNotify === 'function') {
                window.__trackerNotify('❌ ' + (err.message || 'Ошибка'), 'error');
            }
        });
    }

    window.__trkCheckAndShowDone = function(taskId) {
        if (!taskId) return;
        var key = taskId + '|' + ((window.__trkState && window.__trkState.today) || '');
        if (_shown[key]) return;
        _shown[key] = true;
        setTimeout(function() { _shown[key] = false; }, 5000);

        var a = analyze(taskId);
        if (!a) return;
        show(a, function(choice) {
            if (choice === 'close') {
                closeTask(a.task, function() {
                    var dm = document.getElementById('dayModal');
                    if (dm && dm.classList.contains('active') && typeof window.__trkOpenDayModal === 'function') {
                        var st = window.__trkState;
                        if (st && st.currentDay) window.__trkOpenDayModal(st.currentDay);
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    };

    var _nativeFetch = window.fetch;
    if (_nativeFetch && !window.__trkDoneModalV1) {
        window.__trkDoneModalV1 = true;
        window.fetch = function(url, opts) {
            if (typeof url !== 'string' || url.indexOf('/api/tracker/log/save') === -1) {
                return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments);
            }
            if (!opts || (opts.method || 'GET').toUpperCase() !== 'POST') {
                return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments);
            }
            var payload = {};
            try { payload = JSON.parse(opts.body || '{}'); } catch (e) {}
            if (payload.id) return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments);
            if (payload.status !== 'done') return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments);
            if (!payload.task_id) return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments);

            var self = this;
            return _nativeFetch.apply(this, arguments).then(function(r) {
                if (r.status !== 200) return r;
                return r.clone().json().then(function(d) {
                    if (!d || !d.success) return r;
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        try { window.__trkCheckAndShowDone(payload.task_id); } catch (e) {}
                    }, 400);
                    return r;
                });
            });
        };
    }

(function() {
    'use strict';

    function _st() { return window.__trkState || null; }

    function decorateLegend() {
        var legend = document.querySelector('#sumExtras .grid-legend');
        if (!legend) return;
        if (legend.querySelector('.trk-legend-missing')) return;
        var s = document.createElement('span');
        s.className = 'grid-legend-item trk-legend-missing';
        s.innerHTML = '<span class="grid-legend-swatch" style="background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(128,128,128,0.10) 0, rgba(128,128,128,0.10) 3px, rgba(128,128,128,0.28) 3px, rgba(128,128,128,0.28) 6px);"></span>🩶 Назначено, не отмечено';
        legend.appendChild(s);
        if (legend.querySelector('.trk-legend-overdue')) return;
        var s2 = document.createElement('span');
        s2.className = 'grid-legend-item trk-legend-overdue';
        s2.innerHTML = '<span class="grid-legend-swatch" style="background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(231,76,60,0.12) 0, rgba(231,76,60,0.12) 3px, rgba(231,76,60,0.32) 3px, rgba(231,76,60,0.32) 6px);"></span>⚠ Просрочено без отметок';
        legend.appendChild(s2);
    }

    function decorateMissing() {
        var wrap = document.getElementById('sumWrap');
        var table = wrap ? wrap.querySelector('table.grid-table') : null;
        if (!table) return;
        var st = _st();
        if (!st || !st.summary) return;
        var d = st.summary;
        var days = d.days || [];
        var meta = d.day_meta || {};
        var today = st.today || '';
        if (!days.length || !today) return;

        var rowByEmp = {};
        (d.rows || []).forEach(function(r) { rowByEmp[r.employee_id] = r; });

        var trs = table.querySelectorAll('tbody > tr');
        var lastEmpId = '';

        trs.forEach(function(tr) {
            if (tr.classList.contains('emp-sep')) return;
            if (tr.classList.contains('day-totals-row')) return;

            var empCell = tr.querySelector('td.emp-cell[data-emp]');
            if (empCell) lastEmpId = empCell.getAttribute('data-emp');
            if (!lastEmpId) return;

            var taskCell = tr.querySelector('td.task-cell[data-task]');
            if (!taskCell) return;
            var taskId = taskCell.getAttribute('data-task');
            if (!taskId || taskId === '__collapsed__') return;

            var rowData = rowByEmp[lastEmpId];
            if (!rowData) return;
            var taskData = (rowData.tasks || []).find(function(x) { return x.task_id === taskId; });
            if (!taskData) return;

            var taskFull = (st.tasks || []).find(function(x) { return x.id === taskId; });
            if (!taskFull) return;
            var tstatus = taskFull.status || 'active';
            if (tstatus !== 'active' && tstatus !== 'paused') return;
            if ((taskFull.assignees || []).indexOf(lastEmpId) === -1) return;

            var startD = taskFull.start_date || '';
            var endD = taskFull.deadline || '';
            var anyCells = taskData.cells && Object.keys(taskData.cells).length > 0;
            var overdueNoWork = !!(endD && endD < today && !anyCells);

            var absMap = rowData.absence_days || {};

            var dayCells = tr.querySelectorAll('td.day-cell');
            for (var i = 0; i < days.length && i < dayCells.length; i++) {
                var dk = days[i];
                var td = dayCells[i];
                if (td.hasAttribute('data-emp') || td.hasAttribute('data-task')) continue;
                if (absMap[dk]) continue;
                if (td.classList.contains('absence-vacation') ||
                    td.classList.contains('absence-sick_leave') ||
                    td.classList.contains('absence-business_trip') ||
                    td.classList.contains('absence-remote')) continue;
                if (startD && dk < startD) continue;
                if (endD && dk > endD) continue;
                if (dk > today) continue;
                var m = meta[dk] || {};
                if (!m.is_workday) continue;

                var cls = overdueNoWork ? 'day-cell--missing-overdue' : 'day-cell--missing-assigned';
                td.classList.add(cls);
                var ttl = overdueNoWork ? '⚠ Просрочено без отметок' : '🩶 Назначено, не отмечено';
                td.title = (td.title ? td.title + ' · ' : '') + ttl;
            }
        });

        decorateLegend();
    }

    var _prev = window.__trkOnSummaryRender;
    window.__trkOnSummaryRender = function() {
        if (typeof _prev === 'function') {
            try { _prev(); } catch (e) {}
        }
        try { decorateMissing(); } catch (e) { console.error('[missing-shading]', e); }
    };

    setTimeout(function() { try { decorateMissing(); } catch (e) {} }, 700);
    setTimeout(function() { try { decorateMissing(); } catch (e) {} }, 1800);

    window.__trkDecorateMissing = decorateMissing;
})();
/* ============================================================
   PATCH 23 — Глобальная связь задач и отметок

(function() {
    'use strict';

    function _st() { return window.__trkState || null; }
    function _esc(s) {
        return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c) {
            return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];
        });
    }
    function _fmtH(h) {
        h = Number(h) || 0;
        if (h === Math.floor(h)) return h + ' ч';
        return h.toFixed(2).replace(/0+$/, '').replace(/\.$/, '') + ' ч';
    }
    function _mask(name) {
        var st = _st();
        if (!st || !st.maskNames) return name;
        return String(name == null ? '' : name).split(/\s+/).map(function(w) {
            if (w.length <= 1) return w;
            return w[0] + new Array(w.length).join('*');
        }).join(' ');
    }

    function _meEmpId() {
        var st = _st();
        return st && st.currentUser ? (st.currentUser.employee_id || '') : '';
    }

    function _isWorkday(dayMeta) {
        return !!(dayMeta && dayMeta.is_workday);
    }

    function _inInterval(t, dk) {
        var s = t.start_date || '';
        var e = t.deadline || '';
        if (s && dk < s) return false;
        if (e && dk > e) return false;
        return true;
    }

    function _absenceOf(emp, dk) {
        if (!emp) return '';
        var vs = emp.vacations || [];
        for (var i = 0; i < vs.length; i++) {
            var v = vs[i];
            if (v.from && v.to && v.from <= dk && dk <= v.to) return v.type || 'vacation';
        }
        return '';
    }

    function _missingTasksFor(empId, dk) {
        var st = _st();
        if (!st || !st.tasks || !st.calendar) return [];
        var day = st.calendar.days.find(function(d) { return d.date === dk; });
        if (!day) return [];
        var meta = (st.calendar.days.find(function(x) { return x.date === dk; }) || {});
        var today = st.today || '';
        if (dk > today) return [];
        if (!_isWorkday(meta)) return [];
        var emp = (st.employees || []).find(function(e) { return e.id === empId; });
        if (_absenceOf(emp, dk)) return [];
        var doneTask = {};
        (day.entries || []).forEach(function(en) {
            if (en.employee_id === empId) doneTask[en.task_id] = true;
        });
        var out = [];
        (st.tasks || []).forEach(function(t) {
            if (t.status !== 'active' && t.status !== 'paused') return;
            if ((t.assignees || []).indexOf(empId) === -1) return;
            if (!_inInterval(t, dk)) return;
            if (doneTask[t.id]) return;
            out.push(t);
        });
        return out;
    }

    function _decorateDayModal() {
        var st = _st();
        if (!st) return;
        if (st.dayViewMode === 'employee') return;
        var empId = _meEmpId();
        if (!empId) return;
        var dk = st.currentDay;
        if (!dk) return;
        var list = document.getElementById('dayList');
        if (!list) return;
        var missing = _missingTasksFor(empId, dk);
        var old = list.querySelector('.day-assigned-block');
        if (old) old.remove();
        if (!missing.length) return;

        var block = document.createElement('div');
        block.className = 'day-assigned-block';
        var head = '<div class="dab-head">'
                 + '<span class="dab-icon">🩶</span>'

            return '<div class="dab-tile' + cls + '" data-task-id="' + _esc(t.id) + '">'
                 +   '<span class="dab-ico">' + _esc(t.icon || '📋') + '</span>'
                 +   '<div class="dab-body">'

                 + '</div>';
        }).join('');
        block.innerHTML = head + '<div class="dab-tiles">' + tiles + '</div>';

    function _activateTask(taskId) {
        var st = _st();
        if (!st) return;
        var t = (st.tasks || []).find(function(x) { return x.id === taskId; });
        if (!t) return;

        if (t.status === 'done' || t.status === 'archived') {
            var map = { done: 'выполнена', archived: 'в архиве' };
            _showNotice(
                '🔒 Задача закрыта',
                'Задача <b>' + _esc(t.name) + '</b> — ' + map[t.status] + '.',
                'Измените её статус во вкладке «Задачи», чтобы отметить по ней работу.'

    function _doAdd(taskId) {
        var st = _st();
        if (!st) return;
        var empId = _meEmpId();
        var dk = st.currentDay;
        if (!empId || !dk) return;
        var day = st.calendar && st.calendar.days ? st.calendar.days.find(function(d) { return d.date === dk; }) : null;
        var n = 0;
        (day && day.entries || []).forEach(function(en) { if (en.employee_id === empId) n++; });
        var hrs = Math.round((8 / (n + 1)) * 4) / 4;
        if (hrs < 0.5) hrs = 0.5;
        if (hrs > 24) hrs = 24;
        var hdrs = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
        if (window.REESTR_CSRF) hdrs['X-CSRF-Token'] = window.REESTR_CSRF;
        fetch('/api/tracker/log/save', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: hdrs,
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            body: JSON.stringify({
                employee_id: empId,
                task_id: taskId,
                date: dk,
                hours: hrs,
                status: 'in_progress',
                comment: 'Назначенная задача, активирована из календаря',
                link: ''
            })
        }).then(function(r) { return r.json().then(function(d) { return { ok: r.ok, d: d }; }); })
        .then(function(res) {
            if (!res.ok || !res.d || !res.d.success) {
                if (res.d && res.d.error && res.d.error !== 'cancelled' && typeof window.__trackerNotify === 'function') {
                    window.__trackerNotify('❌ ' + res.d.error, 'error');
                }
                return;
            }
            var dm = document.getElementById('dayModal');
            if (dm) dm.classList.remove('active');
            // PATCH v1.0.6: обновляем активную вкладку
            var _refresh = (typeof window.__trkRefreshAll === 'function')
                ? window.__trkRefreshAll
                : (typeof window.__trkRenderCalendar === 'function' ? window.__trkRenderCalendar : null);
            if (_refresh) {
                Promise.resolve(_refresh()).then(function() {
                    if (typeof window.__trkOpenDayModal === 'function') {
                        window.__trkOpenDayModal(dk);
                    }
                });
            }
        }).catch(function(err) {
            if (err && err.message && err.message.indexOf('cancelled') !== -1) return;
            if (typeof window.__trackerNotify === 'function') {
                window.__trackerNotify('❌ ' + (err.message || 'Ошибка'), 'error');
            }
        });
    }

    function _showNotice(title, line1, line2) {

        var i = m.querySelector('#nmIcon'); if (i) i.textContent = title.indexOf('🔒') === 0 ? '🔒' : 'ℹ';

        var onClick = function(e) {
            if (e.target === m || (e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-nm="ok"]'))) {
                m.classList.remove('active');
                m.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
            }
        };
        m.addEventListener('click', onClick);
    }

    // PATCH v2: в _confirmNotice была синтаксическая ошибка — запятая вместо +, 
    // из-за чего в модалке появлялась только кнопка Отмена.
    function _confirmNotice(title, line1, line2, okLabel, onOk) {
        var m = _getNoticeModal();
        var t = m.querySelector('#nmTitle'); if (t) t.textContent = title;
        var i = m.querySelector('#nmIcon'); if (i) i.textContent = '⚠';
        var l1 = m.querySelector('#nmLine1'); if (l1) l1.innerHTML = line1;
        var l2 = m.querySelector('#nmLine2'); if (l2) l2.innerHTML = line2 || '';
        var a = m.querySelector('#nmActions');
        if (a) a.innerHTML = '<button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-nm="cancel">Отмена</button>'
                          + '<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-nm="ok">' + _esc(okLabel) + '</button>';
        m.classList.add('active');
        var onClick = function(e) {
            var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-nm]');
            if (e.target === m) b = { getAttribute: function() { return 'cancel'; } };
            if (!b) return;
            m.classList.remove('active');
            m.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
            if (b.getAttribute('data-nm') === 'ok' && typeof onOk === 'function') onOk();
        };
        m.addEventListener('click', onClick);
    }

    function _decorateCalendar() {
        var st = _st();
        if (!st || !st.calendar) return;
        var empId = _meEmpId();
        if (!empId) return;
        var grid = document.getElementById('calGrid');
        if (!grid) return;
        var cells = grid.querySelectorAll('.cal-cell');
        cells.forEach(function(cell) {
            var dk = cell.getAttribute('data-date');
            if (!dk) return;
            var old = cell.querySelector('.cal-assigned-dot');
            if (old) old.remove();
            var missing = _missingTasksFor(empId, dk);
            if (!missing.length) return;
            var dot = document.createElement('span');
            dot.className = 'cal-assigned-dot';
            dot.title = missing.length + ' назначенных задач(и) без отметки';
            dot.textContent = '●';
            cell.appendChild(dot);
        });
    }

    function _autoCheckInTaskModal() {
        var st = _st();
        if (!st) return;
        var me = _meEmpId();
        if (!me) return;
        var taskIdField = document.getElementById('task_id');
        if (!taskIdField || taskIdField.value) return;
        var list = document.getElementById('taskAssigneesList');
        if (!list) return;
        var cb = list.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"][value="' + me + '"]');
        if (cb && !cb.checked) cb.checked = true;
    }

    function _attachObservers() {
        var dm = document.getElementById('dayModal');
        if (dm && !dm._linksHooked) {
            dm._linksHooked = true;
            new MutationObserver(function() {
                if (dm.classList.contains('active')) {
                    setTimeout(_decorateDayModal, 80);
                    setTimeout(_decorateDayModal, 300);
                }
            }).observe(dm, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
            var dl = document.getElementById('dayList');
            if (dl) {
                new MutationObserver(function() { setTimeout(_decorateDayModal, 40); }).observe(dl, { childList: true });
            }
        }
        var grid = document.getElementById('calGrid');
        if (grid && !grid._assignedHooked) {
            grid._assignedHooked = true;
            new MutationObserver(function() { setTimeout(_decorateCalendar, 60); }).observe(grid, { childList: true });
        }
        var tm = document.getElementById('taskModal');
        if (tm && !tm._autoHooked) {
            tm._autoHooked = true;
            new MutationObserver(function() {
                if (tm.classList.contains('active')) {
                    setTimeout(_autoCheckInTaskModal, 150);
                    setTimeout(_autoCheckInTaskModal, 400);
                }
            }).observe(tm, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
        }
    }

    function boot() {
        _attachObservers();
        setTimeout(_attachObservers, 800);
        setTimeout(_attachObservers, 2000);
        setTimeout(_decorateCalendar, 1000);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
    } else { boot(); }

    window.__trkDecorateAssigned = _decorateDayModal;
    window.__trkDecorateCalendarAssigned = _decorateCalendar;
})();

(function() {
    'use strict';

    function decorate() {
        var st = window.__trkState;
        if (!st || !st.tasks) return;
        var list = document.getElementById('tasksFullList');
        if (!list) return;
        list.querySelectorAll('.task-card, .dict-item').forEach(function(card) {
            var id = card.getAttribute('data-id');
            if (!id) return;
            var t = st.tasks.find(function(x) { return x.id === id; });
            if (!t) return;
            var noAssignees = !((t.assignees || []).length);
            var badge = card.querySelector('.task-card-no-assignees-badge');
            if (noAssignees) {
                card.classList.add('task-card--no-assignees');
                if (!badge) {
                    var b = document.createElement('span');
                    b.className = 'task-card-no-assignees-badge';
                    b.textContent = '⚠ Нет исполнителей';
                    b.title = 'Задача ни на кого не назначена — её никто не увидит в календаре';
                    var head = card.querySelector('.task-card-head') || card.querySelector('.dict-item-body');
                    if (head) head.appendChild(b);
                }
            } else {
                card.classList.remove('task-card--no-assignees');
                if (badge) badge.remove();
            }
        });
    }

        decorate();
    }
    observe(wrap);
    setTimeout(function() { observe(document.getElementById('tasksFullList')); }, 800);
    setTimeout(function() { observe(document.getElementById('tasksFullList')); }, 2000);
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
